Name_560.ru: Познание на Усадьбе ковких мечей - Осень

Desc_0.en: The food of Jingji includes lamb, soup, ribs, and buns of various types...
Desc_0.cn: 京畿食物：羊肉、头羹、大小骨、诸色包子等…
Desc_0.ru: Еда Цзинцзи включает баранину, суп, ребрышки и булочки различных видов...

Desc_1.en: The culture of Capital includes drama, puppetry, novel, music, dance, Chinese wrestling, and shadow play...
Desc_1.cn: 京瓦伎艺有杂剧、傀儡、小说、乐舞、相扑、影戏…

Desc_2.en: The customs of Qixi needlework, colored banners, and the decorative melon craft all came from Jingji...
Desc_2.cn: 七夕女子穿针、结彩、做花瓜之俗，乃是自京畿传出…

Desc_3.en: Due to the scarcity of vegetables in winter, the people of Capital need to stock up on enough winter greens before the Start of Winter...
Desc_3.cn: 冬月无蔬茶，京人需于立冬前收藏冬菜，供一冬之用…

Desc_4.en: A crimson bridge stretches like a rainbow over the river. Willows dip their branches into the waters. Green grass lines the embankments, where people often fish...
Desc_4.cn: 临河朱桥如飞虹，垂杨蘸水，烟草铺堤，常有人垂钓…

Desc_5.en: In the gardens of Jingji, one can occasionally glimpse a vision of the snow-covered forests of the Imperial Palace. Tourists from all over come here for a view of the stone ridges, streams and clouds...
Desc_5.cn: 京畿园囿中仍偶见御殿琼林，游人常常来此观石山云水…

Desc_6.en: The old palace either no longer exists, has collapsed, been rebuilt, or simply disappeared into thin air...
Desc_6.cn: 旧时皇宫现已不存，或已坍圮，或已改建，或凭空消失…

Desc_7.en: Jingji temples often preside over religious banquets and trade in rare items, books, household items, and more...
Desc_7.cn: 京畿寺庙常主持斋会，同时交易珍奇、什物、书籍等…

Desc_8.en: In the old days of Jingji, one could find glamorous carriages, precious horses, and many other lavish displays of wealth across the imperial roads...
Desc_8.cn: 京畿旧时，处处天街御路，上有雕车宝马、花光箫鼓…

Desc_9.en: The cuisine of Shu features Five Flavours. It's very spicy, and often supplemented by sugarcane, ginger, and pepper...
Desc_9.cn: 蜀人饮食尚滋味，好辛香，调五味，常以甘蔗姜椒为佐…

Desc_10.en: Bashu is rich in natural products such as jade and mushrooms, salt springs and iron veins, along with Ox Tail Banner...
Desc_10.cn: 巴蜀物产丰富，有瑕英菌芝、盐泉铁冶、期牛光旄等…

Desc_11.en: Bashu has many entertainments. At the end of the season, many enjoy the talented singers and dancers, along with the sea of flowers in bloom...
Desc_11.cn: 巴蜀好游乐，至时节倾城而出，赏倡优歌舞、十里繁花…

Desc_12.en: The pandas of Shu are as large as bears. Black and white in color, they're docile creatures that mostly sustain themselves on bamboo...
Desc_12.cn: 蜀地有猫熊，大如熊，色黑白，食竹，性温顺，古称貔…

Desc_13.en: The people of Bashu worship the White Tiger, meaning that sacrificial ceremonies are popular. One can occasionally find bronze trees and dummies in their sacrificial pits...
Desc_13.cn: 巴人尚白虎，祭祀盛行，偶现古祭祀坑有铜树、铜人等…

Desc_14.en: Li Bing once built embankments to guide the waters to control the floods. The lands of Shu flourished, and was touted as the heavenly kingdom...
Desc_14.cn: 曾有李冰作堋导水治洪患，蜀地遂水旱不饥，谓之天府…

Desc_15.en: The Emperor Wang Di, Du Yu, transformed into a large hawk cuckoo upon his death and called out. Since then, people reminisced about Emperor Wang Di whenever they saw this bird...
Desc_15.cn: 望帝杜宇去时化子规啼鸣，因此蜀人闻子规而思念望帝…

Desc_16.en: Yu the Great prospered in the Ba region. Later, he ruled the lands of the Yellow River from Bashu and conquered Jiuzhou...
Desc_16.cn: 禹兴于巴地，后治黄河亦从巴蜀始，而通四夷九州…

Desc_17.en: There is a special type of coffin called the "hanging coffin." Placed in the holes of mountain walls, they remind one of a celestial burial...
Desc_17.cn: 有特异墓葬名悬棺，于崖壁孔中放置棺木，如仙人葬骨…

Desc_18.en: There are people who live beneath the waterfall, rearing poultry and livestock beneath them in wooden pens, while they live above in so-called "dry fences"...
Desc_18.cn: 有人居瀑布下，底层木架蓄禽畜，其上住人，音“干栏”…

Desc_19.en: In the old days, the Chieftain established a bureau to study medical techniques such as oral medication, external cleansing, steaming, and poulticing...
Desc_19.cn: 旧时土司设医署，研究内服、外洗、薰蒸、敷贴等医法…

Desc_20.en: Certain people have a custom of stealing one another's vegetables and radishes on the night of the Lantern Festival. For the "victims," this is also a matter of joy...
Desc_20.cn: 元宵夜某族有偷他人青菜、萝卜习俗，被偷者不怒反喜…

Desc_21.en: Rumor has it that babies are flowers planted by the flower mother that have fallen down to earth. Birthed from the flower mother, they worship her in life...
Desc_21.cn: 传言婴孩乃花婆所种神花，落于人间，诞生后需拜花婆…

Desc_22.en: In the old days, song and dance was a way to worship the gods. In our era, such things have become common entertainment, with singing festivals often held in spring or autumn...
Desc_22.cn: 旧时歌舞祭神，现为众人娱乐，有歌圩举于春或秋季…

Desc_23.en: A specialty of Guangnan is the seesaw. Watching people perform tricks on both ends of the crossbar is an interesting experience...
Desc_23.cn: 广南特有打磨秋，木横杆两端有人起落旋转，十分奇妙…

Desc_24.en: A child dressed up to play the role of an official, and the common folks dance in a comical manner while carrying them forward...
Desc_24.cn: 见小童盛装扮官人，众人一边滑稽舞蹈，一边抬其前行…

Desc_25.en: The is a peculiar instrument called the duxianqin. Made of bamboo with carved wood at the head, it features a single string tied to the top...
Desc_25.cn: 有独弦琴，世所奇，斑竹所制，刻木为虺首，以弦系顶…

Desc_26.en: While Guangnan is a hot region, the peaks of its mountains pierce through the clouds like fenghuang, and were once a place of ascendance...
Desc_26.cn: 广南虽热，但有寒山，顶如五凤穿云，曾有仙羽化…

Desc_27.en: Jingbei is located at a strategic chokepoint, and has often been coveted by conquerors. The Three Kingdoms fought many battles over this place...
Desc_27.cn: 荆北地处扼要，历来为兵家必争，三国曾于此盘踞交错…

Desc_28.en: Lacquer trees and gold dust are aplenty here, where there have been lacquer-decorated wares since the Spring and Autumn Periods, whose color never fades...
Desc_28.cn: 地产漆树、沙金，自春秋起便有漆器髹饰工艺，色不衰…

Desc_29.en: The quality drums and gongs of the local area create fierce sounds when struck. They are often used in song, dance, storytelling, and opera...
Desc_29.cn: 当地好锣鼓，敲时激烈如火，可伴歌舞、说书、戏曲等…

Desc_30.en: You must be cautious in your travels. Mountain bandits and pirates are both merciless and fierce...
Desc_30.cn: 行路需谨慎，偶见山盗、水盗，残忍凶悍，神出鬼没…
Desc_30.ru: Вы должны быть осторожны в своих путешествиях. Горные бандиты и пираты одновременно безжалостны и свирепы...

Desc_31.en: The natives have found a way to traverse the steep mountains of Jingbei by constructing a path from wooden planks...
Desc_31.cn: 荆北山势险峻，土人横杙架板成阁道，于是山中可通行…

Desc_32.en: The songs of witchcraft are worshiped somewhere, it is rumored that the Spirit Medium used these songs to communicate with the gods or to heal illnesses...
Desc_32.cn: 某地尚巫音，相传巫祝可通过巫音与神沟通，或可治病…

Desc_33.en: There are many Taoist Temples in Jingbei, all of which are located on famous mountains. They attract pilgrims from all across the realm...
Desc_33.cn: 荆北道观寺庙众多，位于名山之上，天下人皆来此求索…

Desc_34.en: If you're lucky enough to visit the Tomb of the King of Chu, you'll find a bianzhong made of hundreds of bells...
Desc_34.cn: 若有幸见春秋古墓，或为楚王墓，能见上百组件之编钟…

Desc_35.en: Many temples here worship Emperor Shun, who ascended after concocting the pills of immortality in Wood Cave...
Desc_35.cn: 此地多舜祠，因舜禅位后炼丹于某处紫霞洞，白日飞升…

Desc_36.en: Millet, rice and wheat are produced here, which are all large grains. The wheat here has a thin husk and full grains, making it a good source of nutrition...
Desc_36.cn: 地产粟稻黍稷麦，皆穗大，其中麦皮薄多白，食之宜人…

Desc_37.en: The folk customs here are simple, where there are few crimes or disputes. People farm and weave for a living, and help each other out for weddings and funerals...
Desc_37.cn: 此地民风淳朴，耻淫盗少争讼，耕织为生，婚丧相助…

Desc_38.en: The terrain of Hedong is gentle, and it has gained much wealth as the central market for iron and salt, and dominated the Han Dynasty's copper and iron smelting industries...
Desc_38.cn: 河东土地平易，有盐铁之饶，汉时冶天下铜铁…

Desc_39.en: There is a place of thick stone and barren soil, where the Buddha statues of the Cliff Grottoes were carved during the Northern Wei Dynasty...
Desc_39.cn: 有地方石厚土薄地瘠，见摩崖石窟众佛像，自魏起凿…

Desc_40.en: Here there is a resolute vigilante, victorious and generous, which is the legacy of the Western Jin Dynasty...
Desc_40.cn: 此地有刚毅任侠，好胜负气慷慨磊落，有西晋遗风…

Desc_41.en: According to customs, officials are not allowed to ride into the lanes, and property should not be mentioned at weddings. People here live a life of old-fashioned tradition...
Desc_41.cn: 风俗仕宦骑马不入闾里，婚嫁耻于论钱财，颇有古风…

Desc_42.en: The common folk worship the gods and believe in witchcraft, and if there is any injustice, they must ask the gods and often hold the Temple Festival...
Desc_42.cn: 百姓敬神信巫，稍有不平必问于神，常举办庙祀醮赛…

Desc_43.en: Shanxi once practiced cremation, but after an order was engraved by a state governor, the people are now ashamed of burning corpses...
Desc_43.cn: 山西曾行火葬，有知州刻石著令禁止，人遂以焚尸为耻…

Desc_44.en: The Cold Food Festival is dedicated to the memory of Jie Zitui, who was burned to death on the mountain. On this day the common folks do not light fires to cook hot food and pray that elders will live a long and healthy life...
Desc_44.cn: 因子推死于山，寒食百姓莫敢烟㸑，祈祝老少病死者…

Desc_45.en: The common folk sustain themselves on fish, rice and clams, wear wooden sandals, use chicken bones for divination and make merry through song...
Desc_45.cn: 百姓食鱼稻蛏蚌，好着木屐，鸡骨为占，斗歌为乐…

Desc_46.en: The produce of Guangdong includes papayas, bitter gourds, golden berries, lychees, bananas, betel nuts, bayberries and coconuts...
Desc_46.cn: 广东瓜果特有木瓜苦瓜金钗瓜，丹荔黄蕉槟榔杨梅椰子…

Desc_47.en: The days and nights here are similar all year round. There's a saying that it's always summer here, and the occasional autumn when it rains...
Desc_47.cn: 此地年年昼夜长短相似，有说四时俱是夏，一雨便成秋…

Desc_48.en: There are inkstone pits in this mountain where the stone is slippery and delicate, inkstone platforms made from these are world-famous...
Desc_48.cn: 山有石砚坑，石质坚滑细腻，采之造砚台，乃天下名砚…

Desc_49.en: If it rains more on the day of bathing the Buddha, the lychees are abundant enough that common folk use them to pay their respects to the ancestors during the Summer Solstice...
Desc_49.cn: 浴佛日若雨多，则荔枝丰，夏至日百姓擘荔枝荐祖…

Desc_50.en: In Guangdong, the high tides are called the head of the waters, while the low tides are called the tail of the waters. The fisherman catch their harvest during the changing of the tides...
Desc_50.cn: 广东以潮长为水头，潮消为水尾，渔者每于消长时得鱼…

Desc_51.en: In the old days, there were many people who came here, and the world thought this place to be barren and engulfed in a miasma of smoke...
Desc_51.cn: 旧时仕宦谪籍，来此者尤多，世人以为此地荒蛮多烟瘴…

Desc_52.en: There are provinces by the sea, where seafarers often need to brave harsh stormy weather in order to reach Nanyue...
Desc_52.cn: 靠海有州，使船舶渡海常遇风雷，过风雷或可至南越…

Desc_53.en: Occasionally, some people see strange scenery of clouds floating on water, mountains and waters above the clouds, or immortals passing by...
Desc_53.cn: 偶有人见奇景曰云浮水，山水浮云雾之上，或是仙人游…

Desc_54.en: The peninsula lies near the sea, but the windy seas are hard to traverse, so a canal has been built for convenient travel inland...
Desc_54.cn: 半岛临海，然海运有风涛，于是内修运河通衢，遂便利…

Desc_55.en: Shandong is the home and literary center of Confucianism, there are often festivals here in the name of sages and scholars...
Desc_55.cn: 山东尚孔子，常行祭典置先贤先儒位，文学彬彬甲一方…

Desc_56.en: Shandong is by the sea, so the land contains a lot of salt and is not suitable for growing crops. Its people make a living from needlework and harvesting fish and salt...
Desc_56.cn: 齐地负海多卤，不适五谷，遂行女红之业通鱼盐之利…

Desc_57.en: The people of this place are tame and docile, and they dislike long travels, while the women are cautious and virtuous...
Desc_57.cn: 此地百姓敦笃驯良，不好远游，妇人慎内且重节…

Desc_58.en: Regardless of whether it is festive drinking or a lavish party, the people would return home at dusk, and rarely revel into the nights...
Desc_58.cn: 无论喜庆贺饮、浊醪雅会，民薄暮便归，不作长夜欢聚…

Desc_59.en: There are occasionally odd visions here, such as the Qilin appearing, snakes entangled, trees intertwined, and birds of all kinds flocking together...
Desc_59.cn: 地方偶见异象，如麒麟现、蛇负蛇、木连理、五色鸟集…

Desc_60.en: Legend has it that in ancient times there were thirty carpenters who made wheels to build hanging pavilions, traversing from place to place...
Desc_60.cn: 相传古时有木工三十人作转轮造悬阁，行于各地之间…

Desc_61.en: The picking of items such as pine nuts, peaches, and lingzhi in the mountains which can be used as bait for the immortals, eating these often will perhaps make one immortal as well...
Desc_61.cn: 山采松子、桃、华芝等，可能为仙人饵食，常服将羽化…

Desc_62.en: Legend has it that some people went into the deep oceans, ate white stones out of extreme hunger, and after braving through storms, arrived at the island of the immortals...
Desc_62.cn: 相传有人入沧海，饥取白石为食，遇风而见仙岛春景…

Desc_63.en: Jingnan is rich in fish produce, and its common folk eat fish and bamboo shoots with rice, which has all kinds of tastes...
Desc_63.cn: 荆南渔产丰富，百姓常食鱼肉笋米，味有酸甜苦辣…

Desc_64.en: The local dialect of Chu has a unique sound and rhyme, and Chu poetry is made from such rhyming, recording the history of the mountains and rivers...
Desc_64.cn: 楚地方言声韵独特，楚辞以其韵成，写山川历史…

Desc_65.en: One passes through the mountain gorges by boat, and can travel a thousand miles in a day with the winds, but sometimes a headwind pushes one backwards...
Desc_65.cn: 山峡间以舟通行，顺风则一日千里，逆风有时不进反退…

Desc_66.en: This locale produces aromatic grasses such as Aromatic Peppercorns, Orchid Grass, Dogwood Fruit, Jiangli Herb, Wild Ginger, and more...
Desc_66.cn: 当地生芳草，如香椒、兰草、茱萸、江离、杜衡等…

Desc_67.en: There are Yangtze, Han Rivers and Xiangshui, where the waters are filled with countless sails, and the city on water is where the legends of Princess Xiang originate...
Desc_67.cn: 有江汉潇湘水，船帆点点，地如泽国，流传湘妃等传说…

Desc_68.en: The scenery of Xiangshui includes the river snow, rainy valley, Xiangshui night and the Dongting Lake moon...
Desc_68.cn: 潇湘胜景有江天暮雪、山市晴岚、潇湘夜雨、洞庭秋月…

Desc_69.en: The Yellow Crane Tower was built in the Three Kingdoms period, which people ascended to look at the distant scenery. It is spoken of in songs for generations, and is a place that one must not miss...
Desc_69.cn: 黄鹤楼建于三国时，登高览胜，为历代题咏，不可不去…

Desc_70.en: There are many strange caves between the mountains and rivers, and it is said that after passing through a certain cave, you will see the peach blossom gardens...
Desc_70.cn: 山水之间奇洞遍出，相传穿行某洞后，将见桃花源…

Desc_71.en: Some have seen the beautiful mountain ghost riding a red leopard and adorned in colorful garb...
Desc_71.cn: 有人于山中见山鬼，乘赤豹，披薜荔戴女萝，容貌昳丽…
Desc_71.ru: Некоторые видели прекрасного горного призрака верхом на красном леопарде, одетого в красочные одежды...

Desc_72.en: Those who live by the sea rely on fish and salt, while those who live by the mountains make a living from mulberry and hemp, such is the way of the Buddha...
Desc_72.cn: 滨海者恃鱼盐为命，依山者以桑麻为业，大抵好佛法…

Desc_73.en: Where the land is narrow and filled with mountains, the people farm on the steppes. The fields up high have no fear of floods or droughts, and rarely is there ever a year of poor harvest...
Desc_73.cn: 地狭山多随山理田，田高不惧涝，引泉不惧旱，少饥年…

Desc_74.en: Since the war broke out, the scholars and wealthy merchants of Jiangbei have all fled here and thus developed this locale...
Desc_74.cn: 自五代乱离，江北士大夫豪商巨贾多逃难于此，遂发展…

Desc_75.en: Education is highly sought after here, where there is rich culture and a studious atmosphere, that women may study along with men...
Desc_75.cn: 此地崇重学业，有洙泗之风，女子可同男子一起读书…

Desc_76.en: In the words of the poet Guo Pu, this place is untouched by natural disasters, and in the sayings of Tang Dynasty Monks, this place, Nirvana, is untouched by strife...
Desc_76.cn: 郭璞铭云此地遇灾不染，唐僧涅槃䜟云此地永不动干戈…

Desc_77.en: It is said that in the old days, travelers sailed long distances across the oceans without much trouble...
Desc_77.cn: 旧传有番船之饶，行者入海，长驶通夷，交往存亡无患…

Desc_78.en: It is said that women are doted on here, where they would quickly remarry once their husbands died, and wives would abandon their sickly husbands without a thought...
Desc_78.cn: 俗多溺爱女儿，夫死不久即改嫁，老者若病，女即归家…

Desc_79.en: This place takes in abandoned and poor children and takes care of them like their own, legend has it that their kindness has turned the red lotuses white...
Desc_79.cn: 此地得穷子弃儿，抚如己出，传闻人至淳能见红莲变白…

Desc_80.en: There were three immortals who tried to subdue the demon in unorthodox spells, then turned into stone to hide themselves, which is why one can seek shelter within the stones when in danger...
Desc_80.cn: 曾有三仙人异术治妖，后隐身入石，故遇险可寻石庇佑…

Desc_81.en: Liao is a mountainous region, where there is grain, cattle and horses, linen cloth, red jade and fine mink fur...
Desc_81.cn: 辽地多山，有五谷、牛马、麻布，出赤玉、好貂…

Desc_82.en: Liao is surrounded by mountains and filled with rivers, and is famous for its brave warriors. They are ferocious and good in horsemanship and archery, and frequently hold rural hunting competitions...
Desc_82.cn: 辽地阻山带河，跨据雄甲，人性悍善骑射，常办乡射…

Desc_83.en: In the old days, women wore cloth skirts while men wore pigskin fur, with tiger and leopard tails on their heads and face markings...
Desc_83.cn: 旧时妇人穿布裙，男子穿猪皮裘、头插虎豹尾，面纹饰…

Desc_84.en: Liao's soil is extremely cold. There are cave dwellings, for which the deeper they are the better, and they paint their bodies in lard to keep out the cold during winter...
Desc_84.cn: 辽土极寒，有族穴居，以深为贵，冬以猪油涂身以御寒…

Desc_85.en: Liao is famous for producing some expensive medicinal herbs such as Ginseng, Five Taste Herbs, Heartleaf Herb, Balloon Flower, Lingzhi, and more...
Desc_85.cn: 辽地生名贵药材，有人参、五味、细辛、桔梗、灵芝等…

Desc_86.en: In the old days, these were the border regions, and beacon towers and camps were a common sight. The Great Wall of the Qin and Han Dynasties all originated from Liaodong...
Desc_86.cn: 旧时乃边陲地，常见台堡墩营，秦汉长城皆自辽东起始…

Desc_87.en: There are hot springs in the mountains, which boil naturally without fuel. Bathing in its waters cures illnesses, and it is a natural wonder...
Desc_87.cn: 山有温泉，不燃薪气自腾，浴汤能愈疾，乃地生洪炉…

Desc_88.en: There are extraordinaries here who can call like the deer, to attract their herds to then hunt them. They feed on raw meat and drink aged wine...
Desc_88.cn: 有异人能为鹿鸣，可呼群鹿而射之，食生肉饮糜酒…

Desc_89.en: If you ride along the winds, you can see the spirit of the fenghuang soaring in the distance, and the tigers and leopards congregate...
Desc_89.cn: 若乘舞雩之风，可见凤凰翔翱，魑魅远遁，虎豹敛迹…

Desc_90.en: The diet here is mostly cattle, sheep, cheese, puff pastries, coarse sugar, jaggery, and pastry powders...
Desc_90.cn: 此地饮食有牛羊、乳酪、膏酥、砂糖、石蜜、诸饼粉等…

Desc_91.en: The Western Regions produce grapes, pomegranates, sheep and horses, gold and silver, brass stone, white jade and rubies...
Desc_91.cn: 西域出葡萄、石榴、羊马，产金银、鍮石、白玉、火珠…

Desc_92.en: It's warm at midday and cold at night, people are dressed in brown felt, and its people calculative. They would dress in rudimentary clothing despite being immensely wealthy...
Desc_92.cn: 午暖夜寒，人衣毡褐，父子计利，虽富巨万，服食粗弊…

Desc_93.en: Sheep, horses and deer, decorated with bell rings, are tame toward people and wouldn't flee at the sight of Outsiders...
Desc_93.cn: 羊马群鹿，多饰铃环，驯狎于人，见外人不甚惊走…

Desc_94.en: The Western Regions have wines of various tastes. The nobles drink wine made from grapes and sugar cane, while the commoners drink thick tiller wine while making merry...
Desc_94.cn: 西域酒醴各滋味，贵者饮蒲萄、甘蔗，平民饮曲蘖醇醪…

Desc_95.en: There is a salt water lake on these lands which is green and black in color. Its water tastes salty and bitter and is filled with loong fish, but I dare not fish for them...
Desc_95.cn: 陆有咸湖，色带青黑，味兼咸苦，龙鱼杂处，莫敢渔捕…

Desc_96.en: Rumor has it that the books from a certain place are read horizontally from left to right, with characters that differ from those of the Central Plains...
Desc_96.cn: 传闻某地书以横读，自左向右，人物模样异于中土…

Desc_97.en: There are monks who teach at any time and place, erecting Buddha statues among the rocks and hiding into the caves to pray...
Desc_97.cn: 有诸僧徒，设教随时适地，于石壁间立佛像，藏窟告祷…

Desc_98.en: There are many mountains and deep valleys in the Western Regions, where some are ravaged by constant snow, while some others have mountain monsters and phantoms who worship demons...
Desc_98.cn: 西域多高山深谷，风雪相继，有山神鬼魅、暴纵妖祟…

Desc_99.en: There are places in Yunnan that do not see harsh colds during winter or blazing heat during summer, with flowers blooming all year round...
Desc_99.cn: 云南多地冬夏无寒暑，四时花木不绝…

Desc_100.en: In this region, dressing is called "donning garments," eating is "savoring broth and morsels," and chopping wood is "breaking kindling"...
Desc_100.cn: 此地语言穿衣曰衣衣，吃饭曰咽羹茹，伐木曰折薪…

Desc_101.en: The men wear their hair in buns, the women crisp up their hair and bundle them in circles. These are rather unique looks...
Desc_101.cn: 男子披毡椎髻，妇人酥泽其发、绕首盘系，装扮独特…

Desc_102.en: Young people parade in the night, blow reed whistles in song to romance each other to eventually get married...
Desc_102.cn: 少年可暮夜游行，吹芦笙作歌曲，情通私耦，然后成婚…

Desc_103.en: Buddhism is the dominant religion here, where there are Buddhist monasteries regardless of wealth or poverty. In the old days, many heads of state abdicated their positions to become monks...
Desc_103.cn: 佛敎甚盛，家无贫富皆有佛堂，旧时多位国主逊位为僧…

Desc_104.en: The tribe was divided into six clans: Menggui, Yuexi, Langqiong, Tengdan, Shilang, and Mengshe...
Desc_104.cn: 部落分六诏：蒙巂、越析、浪穹、邆赕、施浪、蒙舍…
Desc_104.ru: Племя было разделено на шесть кланов: Менгуи, Юэси, Лангцюн, Тенгдан, Шиланг и Менгше...

Desc_105.en: A man bathes a corpse and cuts his own hair to show filial piety, and beats a bronze drum to send off his loved one at a funeral. His cries are like songs and have no sorrow...
Desc_105.cn: 人死浴尸，击铜鼓送丧，以剪发为孝，哭声如歌而不哀…

Desc_106.en: There is a disease in Wuman that knows no cure, and can only be cured by the wizard's divination with chicken bones. Even the ranks of chieftains are decided as such...
Desc_106.cn: 有乌蛮疾病不识医，惟用男巫鸡骨占，酋长排位亦如此…

Desc_107.en: Someone shot and killed a long-tailed man, whom the natives said was occasionally seen around here. In old age, he would turn into a tiger and return to the mountains...
Desc_107.cn: 有人射死一长尾人，土人言此地偶见，老后将化虎归山…

Desc_108.en: Tofu comes from Huainan, and there is even Guanyin's tofu made from the leaves of trees, which is both delicious and peculiar...
Desc_108.cn: 豆腐自淮南传出，山间更有树叶制观音豆腐，味美奇特…

Desc_109.en: Huainan theatrical arts: flower drum plays, guqin plays and Daoqi plays. In times of poverty, people would busk and perform these plays...
Desc_109.cn: 淮南伎艺：花鼓、琴书、倒七戏，贫时有人以此行乞…

Desc_110.en: The wondrous scene was like the mists and clouds of a Linggu, the winds and moon of Mt. Lu and the welcoming of Songbo, with the mountains as its most scenic spot...
Desc_110.cn: 奇景有如灵谷烟云、庐山风月、松柏迎客，以山为胜…

Desc_111.en: Huainan is famous for producing Huizhou ink, Xuan paper and Xuan inkstone, it is the home of the art of writing...
Desc_111.cn: 淮南所产徽墨、宣纸、宣砚天下闻名，乃笔墨纸砚之乡…

Desc_112.en: The landscape garden here is unique and rigorously-designed, with white crowstepped walls and blue-black tiled roofs, with mountains, rivers, bonsai and Lingbi stones...
Desc_112.cn: 此地园林独特严谨，黛瓦粉壁马头墙，山水盆景灵璧石…

Desc_113.en: Huainan has always been rich in historical figures and texts, and there are many scholars in the city...
Desc_113.cn: 淮南历来人物之盛、文章之富甲于旁邑，城中多文儒…

Desc_114.en: The tea produced here includes Maofeng Tea, Huangya Tea and Lu'an Green Tea, among which it is said that one who drinks Huangya tea may become immortal...
Desc_114.cn: 此地茶有毛峰、黄芽、六安瓜片，传某地黄芽久服得仙…

Desc_115.en: The Peacock Flies Southeast, and there was once a pair of lovers from a certain place whose love never faltered, and they transformed into a pair of mandarin ducks and flew away together...
Desc_115.cn: 孔雀东南飞，某地曾有情人至死不渝，化为鸳鸯双飞去…

Desc_116.en: After Emperor Xuanyuan got rid of the strife on the Central Plains, he went to settle in the mountains, picking herbs and brewing medicine, and finally gained enlightenment and ascended as an immortal...
Desc_116.cn: 轩辕帝定中原后，栖身山中，采药沐汤，终得道飞升…

Desc_117.en: Mulberry silkworms are reared to produce brilliant silk in the Jiangnan regions, which was shipped to the West by the Silk Road in the old days...
Desc_117.cn: 江南养桑蚕，产光丽丝绸，旧时曾由丝绸之路运往西方…

Desc_118.en: Strange teas and soups are sold here all year round. They not only have Longjing Tea, but also serve Seven Treasures Thunder Tea in winter and Snowy Plum Wine in summer...
Desc_118.cn: 四时卖奇茶异汤，不止龙井，冬七宝擂茶，夏雪泡梅花…

Desc_119.en: There are tides along the riverside, which become more raging than usual every August, that the common folk crowd to see the spectacle...
Desc_119.cn: 江边有江潮，每岁八月内，潮怒胜于常时，百姓争观…

Desc_120.en: The Jiangnan Garden is surrounded by lakes and mountains, with strange willows and pines, and is covered in pavilions and terraces for your sightseeing pleasure all year round...
Desc_120.cn: 江南园囿湖光山色，异桧奇松，亭馆台榭，四时供人游…

Desc_121.en: During the festival, there are beautiful youths everywhere, persuading visitors to join them for a drink and giving away desserts for them to enjoy...
Desc_121.cn: 节日时，有风流少年沿途劝酒送点心，游人随处品尝…

Desc_122.en: The common people here have a custom of excavating for treasures, occasionally finding ancient coins, rings, octagonal jade badges, bracelets, ornaments, etc...
Desc_122.cn: 百姓有掘玉之俗，偶见古时璧、环、琮、镯、饰件等…

Desc_123.en: Some rich people built storage houses that were make to look like ordinary shops, but allowed their guests to store goods...
Desc_123.cn: 有富豪起造塌房，专以假赁与铺席宅舍、客旅寄藏物货…

Desc_124.en: As the proverb goes: The benevolent will bring a hundred auspicious things that are blessed by the gods; the malicious will bring a thousand calamities that usher in the disasters of ghosts and gods...
Desc_124.cn: 谚云：善者降百祥，天神佑之；恶者降千灾，鬼神祸之…

Desc_125.en: There is a strange technique in this place, where a winch is used to carry water up to a lamp in a high place, then release it to form a brilliantly lit waterfall...
Desc_125.cn: 有奇技将水用辘轳绞上灯棚高处，逐时放下，瀑布飞光…

Desc_126.en: Huaiyang loves good food, and it has soup dumplings, spring cakes, Shaomai dumplings, boneless fish, and antique soup...
Desc_126.cn: 淮扬好饮食，有灌汤包、春饼、稍麦、没骨鱼、骨董汤…

Desc_127.en: The Jianghuai is fertile and has pure winds, and was once touted as "Yangzhou as the top, Yizhou a close second" in history, and has survived countless cycles of flourishing and decline...
Desc_127.cn: 江淮土沃风淳，史有“扬一益二”之称，兴兴废废终不殆…

Desc_128.en: When it's cold, the common people here love to bathe in hot water pools, with warmed clothing cabinets and rooms nearby to get dressed after...
Desc_128.cn: 微寒时百姓多爱浴池，近炉水热，旁有贮衣之柜、暖房…

Desc_129.en: Jiangbei is the landing spot for the ships coming from the south, where one embarks on land and travels north on horseback. One can see both the plains and arch bridges from here...
Desc_129.cn: 江北为南船北马、舍舟登陆之处，既见平原又见虹桥…

Desc_130.en: In the old days, countless beautifully-painted pleasure boats gathered here, while the song boats traveled upstream. The sounds of conversations and singing intermingled and formed a harmonious melody...
Desc_130.cn: 旧时画舫云集，歌船逆行，清唱、对白，人与歌者相洽…

Desc_131.en: Copper rulers and intricately woven fabric are local specialties, measuring on the world's behalf, with fifteen different variations...
Desc_131.cn: 地产铜尺，朱碧绣错，为天下度量，时人考制有十五种…

Desc_132.en: At Jianghuai, bandits often formed into groups in places where money was moved around, and they lived in abundance during the times when robbery flourished...
Desc_132.cn: 江淮钱财转运处，群盗尝结义兄弟，流劫其间衣食丰足…

Desc_133.en: Occasionally on a moonlit night, the vines on the walls would turn into the form of an old man who would stroll along the streets. Digging the ground beneath them would yield some elixirs...
Desc_133.cn: 偶有月夜，墙上藤影化老人形游于街，掘其地可得灵药…

Desc_134.en: If someone dreams at night, of carrying twelve inkstones in his arms, the skies will become strange, and a great talent will surely be born in this place...
Desc_134.cn: 若有人夜梦十二砚入怀，则天行奇气，此地必诞宏才…

Desc_135.en: The Shaolin Temple is located in the dense jungles of Shaoshi Mountain, hence its name...
Desc_135.cn: 少林寺坐落于少室山丛林茂密之处，故而得名…
Desc_135.ru: Храм Шаолинь расположен в густых джунглях горы Шаоши, отсюда и его название...

Desc_136.en: A variety of vegetables are grown in the back mountain of Shaoshi Temple, including cabbages, pumpkins, sweet potatoes, and more...
Desc_136.cn: 少林寺后山种植菜蔬，有白菜、南瓜、番薯等物…

Desc_137.en: The disciples of Shaolin engage in meditation and reach enlightenment in a place called the Buddhist Temple. They are often filled with pear trees...
Desc_137.cn: 少林弟子参禅悟道之所，称作禅院。其地遍植梨木…

Desc_138.en: At the foot of Mt. Song is the grave of Shaolin Eminent Monks. As the tombstones are scattered across the grounds, people call it the Pagoda Forest...
Desc_138.cn: 嵩山山脚下，乃少林高僧墓寝，墓碑散乱如林，称塔林…

Desc_139.en: The Shaolin Temple has four wells. Each of them draws water of a different flavor, from bitter, spicy, sour, to sweet...
Desc_139.cn: 少林寺有四眼井，其水味各异，有苦、辣、酸、甜滋味…

Desc_140.en: The thirteen Shaolin warrior monks were rewarded by Emperor Taizong for serving the dynasty well, and became renowned for their martial prowess...
Desc_140.cn: 少林十三僧助唐有功，受唐太宗封赏，故有僧兵之名…

Desc_141.en: According to legend, Bodhidharma was moved to teach Dazu Huike when the latter cut off his arm as a show of devotion...
Desc_141.cn: 相传神光求法，立雪断臂，终于感动达摩，而得真法…

Desc_142.en: In the Shaolin Temple, there is a tea tree made from the eyelids of Bodhidharma. Drinking tea made from its leaves gives one a clear mind...
Desc_142.cn: 少林寺中有一株达摩眼皮所化之茶树，饮之便神智清明…

Desc_143.en: According to legend, there is a stone cave near Shaolin Temple where Bodhidharma faced a wall for nine years, not speaking for the entire time...
Desc_143.cn: 相传少林寺中有一石洞，乃达摩祖师面壁九年之处…

Desc_144.en: The Jinding stands on the peak of Mt. Emei. When the sun sets, it shines with the light of the Buddha...
Desc_144.cn: 金顶立于峨眉山上，至夕阳西下，金顶便有佛光普照…

Desc_145.en: The Thousand Buddha Temple in Mt. Emei is filled with thousands of statues of the Buddha, and murals that go on for many li...
Desc_145.cn: 千佛院立于峨眉，殿内奉佛像千尊，佛祖壁画蜿蜒千米…

Desc_146.en: There is a giant bell on Mt. Emei. Weighing over 25,000 catties, its sound travels far and wide...
Desc_146.cn: 峨眉有一顶大钟，一人高，二万五千斤重，声能传千里…
Desc_146.ru: На горе Эмэй есть гигантский колокол. При весе более 25 000 килограммов его звук разносится далеко-далеко...

Desc_147.en: It is said that a monk walked two li, planting trees with a prayer...
Desc_147.cn: 传有僧人植木于峨眉，种一树，诵经一字，今延袤二里…
Desc_147.ru: Рассказывают, что один Монах прошел два ли, сажая деревья с молитвой...

Desc_148.en: There is a cave on Mt. Emei where water seeps and drips into a spring...
Desc_148.cn: 峨眉山中一洞，岩水渗滴成泉，其水取不竭，不取不盈…
Desc_148.ru: На горе Эмэй есть пещера, где вода просачивается и стекает в родник...

Desc_149.en: There is a Lake Tai Rock on Mt. Emei, which when decocted can cure any mental ailment...
Desc_149.cn: 峨眉有一太湖石，以此石煎汤服之，可疗心气疼痛…
Desc_149.ru: На горе Эмэй есть скала озера Тай, отвар которой может вылечить любое психическое заболевание...

Desc_150.en: Overlooking the chasm, many have sacrificed their lives on the Sacrifice Chasm of Jinding in search of ascension...
Desc_150.cn: 峨眉金顶舍身崖，下临深渊，人为飞升，于是舍身献崖…

Desc_151.en: There is a pond in Mt. Emei that is rumored to be the home of a white loong. When the pond is clear, the White Loong may come out to bask in the sun...
Desc_151.cn: 峨眉有一池，传言居有白龙，晴朗时，白龙或出池晒日…

Desc_152.en: Legend has it ever since Qu Junwu achieved ascendance on Mt. Emei, they can often be found travelling to and from the mountain on a White Loong...
Desc_152.cn: 相传瞿君武入峨眉，得道成仙后，常乘白龙往来峨眉…

Desc_153.en: At the entrance to the Valley of Flowers, there is a small seam between the rocks, enough for one person to slide through...
Desc_153.cn: 百花谷入口，两石夹岸，有一小缝，可一人侧身而行…

Desc_154.en: Those who live in the Valley of Flowers build stilt houses and straw huts, hiding their village within the vegetation. Looking from a distance, one can see nothing but nature...
Desc_154.cn: 百花谷筑干栏巢居，掩于草木建寨，远望见草木不见屋…

Desc_155.en: There are deep springs in the Valley of Flowers with wooden structures built on top of them...
Desc_155.cn: 百花谷有深泉，其上建有木楼，楼不沉，仿佛浮于水上…
Desc_155.ru: В Долине цветов есть глубокие источники, на вершине которых построены деревянные сооружения...

Desc_156.en: In the Valley of Flowers lives the Bo and Black Lolo peoples. One covers themselves in white, while the other wears hairpins of bone...
Desc_156.cn: 百花谷有僰人、黑猓猡，一者肤白，一者插骨簪…

Desc_157.en: On the third of every March, the disciples of the Valley of Flowers decorate a deer with hundreds of flowers as a way to honor the God of Flowers...
Desc_157.cn: 逢三月三，百花谷弟子便以百花饰鹿，称作送花神…

Desc_158.en: There is a deer spring in the Valley of Flowers. Its water is clear and cool in summer, yet warm in winter...
Desc_158.cn: 百花谷谷中有一洗鹿泉，其水清澈，夏凉冬温…

Desc_159.en: There is a monument standing in the middle of the Valley of Flowers in the likeness of Sun Simiao encountering a white stag while gathering herbs...
Desc_159.cn: 百花谷谷中立有碑，书见鹿台，乃孙思邈采药见白鹿处…

Desc_160.en: Legend has it that when the deer dies, the disciples of the Valley of Flowers bury it in the orchards while playing the Deer Burial Orchid...
Desc_160.cn: 相传鹿死之后，百花谷弟子以兰花葬鹿，吹奏葬鹿兰…

Desc_161.en: According to legends, the White Deer lives in the seventieth cave of the Valley of Flowers. But near the third cave, one can hear the cries of a deer...
Desc_161.cn: 相传百花谷七十洞，为白鹿居所。掷花第三洞，有鹿鸣…

Desc_162.en: The bamboo forest under the Wudang Mountains is vast and remains verdant no matter the season. The sounds of music can often be heard from the disciples playing there...
Desc_162.cn: 武当山下竹林广袤，四季长青，常有武当弟子于此修心养性…

Desc_163.en: Zhenwu Temple stands on Tianzhu Peak. A statue of Zhenwu is enshrined within its halls...
Desc_163.cn: 真武殿立于天柱峰上，殿内供奉真武大帝像，香火不衰…
Desc_163.ru: Храм Чжэньву стоит на вершине Тяньчжу. В его залах установлена статуя Чжэньву...

Desc_164.en: Since the advent of the Qin Dynasty, many sages have lived in seclusion in the back mountains of Wudang...
Desc_164.cn: 自秦时起，武当后山便多有圣贤隐居，听闻有得道者…

Desc_165.en: Plum blossoms cover the Wudang Mountains. Legend has it that when Zhenwu cultivated his power, each plum tree bloomed its own harvest...
Desc_165.cn: 武当山中植樃梅。相传真武修道得成，梅插樃树而生花…

Desc_166.en: Tianzhu Peak is one of the 72 peaks of the Wudang Mountains. When one looks up, one can see the circling of skylarks and auspicious sparrows...
Desc_166.cn: 天柱峰居于武当七十二峰之中，灵鸟瑞雀，徘徊于四周…

Desc_167.en: Under Nanyan Temple, stone has been chiseled in the shape of a loong's head. Place an incense burner in front, and the purity of your spirit will be revealed...
Desc_167.cn: 武当南岩之下，凿石为龙首，置香炉于前，心诚便至…

Desc_168.en: Rappelling down from a stone cave in the Wudang Mountains, the rocks around oneself look to be on fire...
Desc_168.cn: 自武当山一石穴中，自上贯绳而下，便见山石作火焰状…

Desc_169.en: In the Wudang Secret Realm, stones are made from gold and silver. With so little trace of human presence, there are many spiritual items still within...
Desc_169.cn: 武当秘境，石作金银色，因罕有人迹，故灵物得以枚居…

Desc_170.en: The stone path to the east of Wudang Mountains is perfectly straight, which often has the effect of unnerving those that traverse it. It's called the immortal pass...
Desc_170.cn: 武当山东，石径笔直，游人至此，万虑豁然，故称仙关…

Desc_171.en: Greater Yuanshan is extremely dangerous and difficult to climb. Its peak is slighter higher than Lesser Yuanshan...
Desc_171.cn: 大元山卓立险绝，难以攀登，与小元山相对，较之略高…

Desc_172.en: Lesser Yuanshan is covered in rubble, making it difficult to traverse. Its peak is slighter shorter than Greater Yuanshan...
Desc_172.cn: 小元山碎石繁多，往来艰难，与大元山相对，较之略矮…

Desc_173.en: The disciples of the Yuanshan Sect live in stone houses in the Greater and Lesser Yuanshan that are hot in summer and cold in winter...
Desc_173.cn: 大小元山置有石屋，居之夏热冬寒，乃是元山弟子居所…

Desc_174.en: There is a carved stone on the peaks of Greater & Lesser Yuanshan. One is called the Sword Stone, and the other is the Blade Stone...
Desc_174.cn: 大小元山山顶各有一石中分，一称试剑石，一称试刀石…

Desc_175.en: On Lesser Yuanshan is a Buddha carved from boulders. On Greater Yuanshan is a path that has become one with the mud...
Desc_175.cn: 小元山置石佛，顽石雕琢；大元山置泥道，溲泥和成…

Desc_176.en: A monument was constructed on Greater & Lesser Yuanshan to honor masters that have fallen while fighting Xiangshu...
Desc_176.cn: 大小元山立有碑石，上载因抵抗相枢而亡的师长之名讳…

Desc_177.en: The small birds of Lesser Yuanshan often fly from roof to roof, singing their own little song. Those that live on the mountain say their cries are the word of Buddha...
Desc_177.cn: 小元山常有小鸟，飞止屋头鸣，人译其语，曰佛现佛现…

Desc_178.en: On the east gap between Greater & Lesser Yuanshan, a stone stairway drops from the clouds. It's commonly known as the Mortal Descent...
Desc_178.cn: 大小元山夹缝东处，有石梯自云间下，俗称下界石…

Desc_179.en: There is a stone on Greater Yuanshan in the shape of a palm. Known as the Heart Stone, it loses stability when the mortal heart is impure...
Desc_179.cn: 大元山置石，状如掌，称试心石，凡心不纯，当立不稳…

Desc_180.en: The wooden roofs of the Lion-Face Clan are three to four zhang in diameter, black as iron, and strong enough to resist the impact of a boulder...
Desc_180.cn: 狮相门梁栋三四丈径，色黑如铁，巨石与之相撞不能损…

Desc_181.en: In the Slumbering Lion Hall lies a mighty Aureate Lion statue of the sect's namesake. Disciples face the statue when training their Martial Arts...
Desc_181.cn: 睡狮堂置金狮像，威赫庄严。门人皆面对狮像习练功法…

Desc_182.en: The three halls of the Lion-Face Clan were built around its training grounds, in which lion flags abound and the disciples brawl and shout vigorously...
Desc_182.cn: 狮相门三堂绕校场而建。校场扬狮子幡，门人恶斗呐喊…

Desc_183.en: The Splendid Lion Hall is both vast and gloriously ornamented. Many come from across the realm for an audience with its Leader...
Desc_183.cn: 锦狮堂占地广袤，雕梁画栋，四海来者多于此拜见门主…

Desc_184.en: The disciples of the Lion-Face Clan sell agarwood to the rich seeking redemption...
Desc_184.cn: 狮相门门人捉富者曰沉香，买沉香以待赎，是曰挑香…
Desc_184.ru: Ученики клана Львинолицых продают агаровое дерево богатым в поисках выкупа...

Desc_185.en: Foreign ships have arrived by the shores of the Lion-Face Clan. The children they have bestowed to the sect have bodies as white as the snow...
Desc_185.cn: 狮相门有红毛舶至，以白小子赠人，面与手足皆如玉雪…

Desc_186.en: Silver and gold starstones can be found in the Lotus Hill. When broken into pieces and taken with water, they can give one peace of mind...
Desc_186.cn: 莲花山中有银星石、金星石，可碎成末以水服之，安心…

Desc_187.en: Every night, lions roam the corridors of the Lion-Face Clan to find human prey...
Desc_187.cn: 每至夜，狮相门有狮虎为之巡廊。常食生人…
Desc_187.ru: Каждую ночь львы бродят по коридорам клана Львинолицых в поисках человеческой добычи...

Desc_188.en: The Wild Lion Hall stands between the others and is filled with golden lions, the western regions tributes...
Desc_188.cn: 狂狮堂立于三堂之中，其内豢养金毛雄狮，为西域贡品…

Desc_189.en: There is a Taoist Temple on the peak of Ranshan Mountain. From this temple, immortal masters often gaze into the moon and stars in search of the Tao...
Desc_189.cn: 然山山顶建有道观，仙师常于其上观星望月，以求证道…

Desc_190.en: A wealth of Poria and Polygonatum grows between the cliffs of Ranshan Mountain...
Desc_190.cn: 然山的山崖峭壁之间，生长有许多茯苓、黄精…
Desc_190.ru: Между утесами горы Жаньшань произрастает множество видов пории и полигонатума...

Desc_191.en: There is no path to the Qinglang Chasm of Ranshan Mountain, which cannot be reached by non-immortals. Despite this, there is a Qinglang Pavilion on its cliffs...
Desc_191.cn: 然山青琅崖险绝无路，非仙人不能至。崖上建有青琅阁…

Desc_192.en: The disciples of Ranshan Mountain do not eat grains. Instead, they eat Bai Zhu and drink water...
Desc_192.cn: 然山弟子或有不食五谷，吃白朮而饮水者…
Desc_192.ru: Ученики горы Жаньшань не едят злаков. Вместо этого они едят Бай Чжу и пьют воду...

Desc_193.en: In front of the Ranshan Mountain Sect is an expanse of plum groves. They remain in bloom across all four seasons, and one can no longer find their direction once inside...
Desc_193.cn: 然山门前植有梅林，梅开四季不落，人入其中不辨八方…

Desc_194.en: In the west cave of Ranshan Mountain lives the Divine Loong. From its voice is summoned great magical power, barring the path west...
Desc_194.cn: 然山之西洞为神龙居，闻人声，则有风雨，故西面无路…

Desc_195.en: Rumor has it that there is an immortal stone on Ranshan Mountain. If obtained by a mortal, it can answer all their questions, and make all their wishes come true...
Desc_195.cn: 传言然山有一问仙石，凡人若有所问所求，皆可如愿…

Desc_196.en: To the east of Ranshan Mountain is a cliff on which immortals are often sighted in fur coats and other strange garments...
Desc_196.cn: 然山之东有一崖，神仙出没，神仙或披蓑衣，或怪异相…

Desc_197.en: After the first hundred years of Guiguzi's life, no one knows where he went. In fact, he had hidden away on Ranshan Mountain...
Desc_197.cn: 传说鬼谷先生活百余岁，后人不知去向，其实隐于然山…

Desc_198.en: The Jade-Maiden Peak has accumulated years of ice. It remains cold and snowy even in summer...
Desc_198.cn: 璇女峰岁积寒冰，夏仍飞雪，鲜有炎暑，十分清凉…
Desc_198.ru: На пике Девы Нефрита годами скапливался лед. Здесь остается холодно и снежно даже летом...

Desc_199.en: Legend has it that a goddess once descended onto the Celestial Maiden Peak, which is why it is now called the Jade Maiden...
Desc_199.cn: 传说曾有天女降于峰上，于是时人便称此峰作玉女峰…

Desc_200.en: The bluestones on the Jade-Maiden Peak snake into steps. They make a sound similar to that of broken jade when stepped on, hence they are called the Emerald Stairs...
Desc_200.cn: 璇女峰中青石蜿蜒成阶，人踩石阶响如玉碎，称作玉阶…

Desc_201.en: There are finches living on the Jade-Maiden Peak. When they hear the clapping of hands, a single bird starts to sing, and is soon joined by its entire flock...
Desc_201.cn: 璇女峰中栖有雀，人一鼓掌，则一鸟先鸣，群鸟次相和…

Desc_202.en: Frozen water flows throughout the Jade-Maiden Peak. Its light is a mirror sheen, creating a reflection as beautiful as the divine...
Desc_202.cn: 璇女峰中雪水流经处，其光如鉴，可照人眉目，美如仙…

Desc_203.en: The sound of music has never stopped ringing out the Celestial Melody Pavilion built into the Celestial Maiden Peak...
Desc_203.cn: 天音阁背靠玉女峰，阁内琴声传扬，从不止歇…

Desc_204.en: Water droplets from a stone cave in the Jade-Maiden Peak have formed into a spring. The so-called "Jade Spring" can sustain thousands of people a day...
Desc_204.cn: 璇女峰一石洞内水滴成泉，人称瑶池水，日可饮千人…

Desc_205.en: Legend has it that when the goddess ascended back into the heavens, a staircase appeared, from which the cold water of the Jade-Maiden Peak flowed down...
Desc_205.cn: 相传天女登天时变化天梯。璇女峰上寒水便自天梯而下…

Desc_206.en: There was once a woman who lived in the Jade-Maiden Peak. The sound of her songs would travel for li, beautiful enough for the birds to linger...
Desc_206.cn: 曾有夫人居璇女峰，其弹琴，闻于数里，众鸟徘徊不去…

Desc_207.en: The back mountain of the Swordsmith Villa is tranquil, lush with trees, and abundant in mineral deposits and clear spring water...
Desc_207.cn: 铸剑山庄后山，清幽树茂，矿藏丰裕，泉水清冽…

Desc_208.en: During the Tang Dynasty, a monument was erected on the Mount Zhanlu to honor Zhanlu. Damaged by time and the elements, it's now known as the Broken Monument...
Desc_208.cn: 湛卢山唐时立一碑，记湛卢，后因风雨摧折，便名断碑…

Desc_209.en: The Manor of the Swordsmith Villa is composed of an inner and outer ring of thousands of houses, and can accommodate up to 10,000 people...
Desc_209.cn: 铸剑山庄庄园由内外环楼组成，合屋舍千间，容纳万人…

Desc_210.en: The stream on the Mount Zhanlu snakes with the pinewood forest. Where water flows through, one can hear the plucking of instruments...
Desc_210.cn: 湛卢山中水涧横置松木，每有水流经，便闻流水如琴瑟…

Desc_211.en: The foundry houses thousands of furnaces. The fire burns through day and night, and the sound of iron striking iron rings all year...
Desc_211.cn: 铸造坊内铸炉千尊，炉火日夜不熄，打铁声终年不辍…

Desc_212.en: It's rumored that when the elderly enter the Mount Zhanlu, they can fold branches on the sides of its rocks to relieve their pain...
Desc_212.cn: 传言老人入湛卢山时，折岩石边树枝，可以解腰腿酸疼…

Desc_213.en: The Swordsmith Villa has a Sword-Practice Platform. Stones have been laid on top, while below are swords and halberds stacked as high as a mountain...
Desc_213.cn: 铸剑山庄有试剑台，上置石块，其下刀枪剑戟如山高…

Desc_214.en: In the Swordsmith Villa stands a Sword Stone, which was cut apart by the Zhanlu, crafted by Ou Yezi himself...
Desc_214.cn: 铸剑山庄有一块验剑石，乃湛卢宝剑斩裂，欧冶子所留…

Desc_215.en: In the Swordsmith Villa is the divine pillow of Ou Yezi. Aspiring sword-makers burn incense and pray on it for protection...
Desc_215.cn: 铸剑山庄置欧冶子仙枕，铸剑师多于此燃香，以求护佑…

Desc_216.en: From Mt. Kongsang is grown a wood as strong as iron. The unique sounds this wood generates when struck has made it a popular material for the crafting of instruments...
Desc_216.cn: 空桑山产木，材坚如铁，磕碰有音，人常以此制琴瑟…

Desc_217.en: East from Mt. Kongsang are the Snowy Mountains, bright and clear as silver...
Desc_217.cn: 立空桑山间东望，有雪山，晴明时可见，累积山头如银…
Desc_217.ru: К востоку от горы Кунсан находятся заснеженные горы, яркие и прозрачные, как серебро...

Desc_218.en: The Earth Mounds on Mt. Kongsang are half a man high and hollow in the middle. The locals call them mud houses...
Desc_218.cn: 空桑山中土丘林立，如半人高，其间中空，称作土屋…

Desc_219.en: The west of Mt. Kongsang is surrounded by 600 mu of Herb Garden, where lingzhi, snow ginseng, and snow lotus are planted...
Desc_219.cn: 空桑山西处围六百亩作药园，植灵芝、雪参、雪莲…

Desc_220.en: There are countless amethyst Pill Forges on Mt. Kongsang. From their alchemy one can often see blue smoke and purple mist...
Desc_220.cn: 空桑山置紫翠丹房不胜数，常是青烟紫雾，丹灶凝云…

Desc_221.en: Mt. Kongsang is full of plants and trees in various colors and tall as cows. Few have ever laid an eye on such wonders...
Desc_221.cn: 空桑山草木有异，色纷而杂，高大如牛者，人鲜能识之…

Desc_222.en: On Mt. Kongsang is a crypt of unfathomable depths, from the entrance one can see the white glow of the White Snake that lives inside...
Desc_222.cn: 空桑有一地穴，下探无际，隐约泛光，传为白蛇居所…

Desc_223.en: Those who try to make it up Mt. Kongsang are beset by mist and clouds, with a beast blocking their path...
Desc_223.cn: 若有强欲上山者，空桑山便薄雾云横，猛兽蹲踞道旁…

Desc_224.en: On the Secret Realm of Kongsang sits three peaks in which it is always springtime. The flowers and trees remain verdant, and one can see bees and butterflies buzzing across the skies...
Desc_224.cn: 空桑秘境三峰环列，四时如春，花木不凋而蜂蝶缭乱…

Desc_225.en: The Vajra Hall features Dharani pillars and a Vajra Statue, on which a cipher is written on the plaques on both sides...
Desc_225.cn: 金刚殿中立八角大柱，奉金刚尊像，两侧牌匾书有密文…

Desc_226.en: The back garden of the Vajra Sect is used to raise herds of elephants. The water diverts to form a river, giving life to fields of bounty...
Desc_226.cn: 无量金刚宗后园豢养象群，于是引水成河，垒瓜果如山…

Desc_227.en: A relic of the Vajra Sect is the Shakyamuni Tooth. Yellow and white in color, the long tooth furnishes the main hall...
Desc_227.cn: 金刚宗有佛牙，长寸余，色黄白光净，为僧人陈设大殿…

Desc_228.en: In the Vajra Sect stands nine hundred and ninety-nine golden pillars, in the middle of which stands a statue of the honorable Vajra...
Desc_228.cn: 金刚宗立九百九十九金柱屏峙四方，其间奉金刚尊者像…

Desc_229.en: In front of the Vajra Sect is an expanse that goes on for thousands of li. The upper platform is known as the Sanctuary of Benediction, on which is an offering box...
Desc_229.cn: 金刚殿前开阔百里，设高台称加持殿，上置功德箱…

Desc_230.en: The Vajra Sect practices the art of double cultivation, which holds that when men and women are in harmony, they will reach enlightenment...
Desc_230.cn: 无量金刚宗信仰双修之法，认为男女和合时，会得觉悟…

Desc_231.en: When the eminent monks of the Vajra Sect pass away, their mortal bodies turn into a rainbow, floating away into the sky...
Desc_231.cn: 无量金刚宗高僧圆寂之时，肉身便会化作一道天虹飞去…

Desc_232.en: Gathering water from the Four Seas and placing them in a container on top of the Imperial Roof ensures that the realm will prosper...
Desc_232.cn: 将四海之水以四宝瓶盛之，灌于帝王顶，能使国家隆盛…

Desc_233.en: If the unenlightened attempt to practice the techniques and observe the scriptures of the Vajra Sect, they are surely doomed to hell...
Desc_233.cn: 若无灌顶者修习无量金刚宗，观其典籍，则必下地狱…

Desc_234.en: The Five Immortals Sect built a fortified village. Going up the foot of the mountain, one sees thousands of families connected by the river...
Desc_234.cn: 五仙教建山寨，自山脚顺势而上，千家相连，水过门前…

Desc_235.en: The congregants of the Five Immortals Sect are hunters and fishers. When the Sect makes its call, crowds assemble...
Desc_235.cn: 五仙教教众亦乃渔猎农桑之人，教内啸呼，则众集聚…

Desc_236.en: The congregants of the Five Immortals Sect worship nature. Insect Totems can be seen all across the rocks...
Desc_236.cn: 五仙教教众崇拜自然，其山石之上处处可见虫豸图腾…

Desc_237.en: The Five Immortals Sect stands by a damp valley filled with poisonous snakes, where people enter but never exit...
Desc_237.cn: 五仙教依谷而立，其谷内潮湿，毒蛇肆虐，人有进无出…

Desc_238.en: The congregants of the Five Immortals Sect often poison the bottom of a bowl. This way once the victim picks up the bowl, it's already too late for them...
Desc_238.cn: 五仙教教众常将蛊置于碗底，人一持碗，则必中蛊…

Desc_239.en: In the Five Immortals Sect lives the Black Miao. While they are experts at poison, their lifespans are short and their numbers are low...
Desc_239.cn: 五仙教有名黑苗者，多擅毒蛊，然寿元不长，人丁单薄…

Desc_240.en: There is a spring behind the Five Immortals Sect. The color of the spring water changes constantly, and it is known to be highly poisonous...
Desc_240.cn: 五仙教谷后有一泉，泉水之色常生变化，其中有剧毒…

Desc_241.en: Within the Cave of Gu, the Five Immortals Sect breeds deadly worms that run rampant with the five poisons...
Desc_241.cn: 蛊洞乃五仙教孵育虫蛊之处，洞内毒虫横行，五毒具有…

Desc_242.en: Those who practice the proper techniques of Gu can poison their enemies through a breath or a magical gaze...
Desc_242.cn: 凡练蛊术精者，嘘之以气，视之以目，皆能传其毒于人…

Desc_243.en: On the east of Veil Scar Cliff lies a stone shaped like a tooth. Humans find a purpose for anything, and this place has long been used by bandits to avoid capture...
Desc_243.cn: 界青崖东面石作张牙状，有井臼犹存，旧为匪贼避兵处…

Desc_244.en: No life grows by Veil Scar Cliff. Instead, Veil disciples collect the rainwater that builds up in the stones...
Desc_244.cn: 界青崖不生草木，雨水积于石中，门人便往石中取水…

Desc_245.en: The rocks of Veil Scar Cliff are sharp and contort into strange shapes. Many have fallen from such...
Desc_245.cn: 界青崖崖上山石尖锐，多奇异状，常有人因此而丧命…

Desc_246.en: The caves of Veil Scar Cliff allow for unimpeded travel. One cannot be easily tracked once within their depths...
Desc_246.cn: 界青崖之洞窟，处处通融无碍，人一入其中便不得踪迹…

Desc_247.en: To the east of Veil Scar Cliff, sharp stones protrude in the shape of a ladder. They call it "The Precipice"...
Desc_247.cn: 界青崖东，尖石凸出次序成梯，笔直而上，人称作忘生…

Desc_248.en: Just how high does the monument on Veil Scar Cliff peak stand? One can look down upon the stars, hence its moniker of the "Stargazing Cliff"...
Desc_248.cn: 界青崖顶立碑：立处多高？星辰在下。人称其作观星崖…

Desc_249.en: The Stargazing Cliff descends into a cave in which light sways and flickers, surely the doing of ghosts...
Desc_249.cn: 观星崖下山石成窟，窟内灯火明灭摇晃，乃是鬼在点灯…

Desc_250.en: Strange beasts lurk in the chasm below Veil Scar Cliff. They feed on human corpses, and can often be heard chewing bones...
Desc_250.cn: 界青崖下深渊有异兽，以人尸体为食，常可闻其嚼骨声…

Desc_251.en: At the bottom of the Demise Abyss lies the Hand of the Immortal. Inaccessible by the common mortal, it only responds to the enlightened...
Desc_251.cn: 名仙人手者，在无生渊底，人不能至，登之可得仙人应…

Desc_252.en: There is an isolated mountain on Chiming Island, from which a mist falls to cover the skies and seas in red...
Desc_252.cn: 赤明岛有一山孤立，其时而喷云吐雾，海天便赤红一色…

Desc_253.en: The columns and stone pillars tower into the clouds on Chiming Island. Their colors gray and black, they sear the skin of those that dare touch...
Desc_253.cn: 赤明岛上石柱纵列，高耸入云，色多灰黑，触之灼肤…

Desc_254.en: Chiming Island The spring water of Chiming Island boils with a pungent smell. Anything thrown into such springs won't take long to cook...
Desc_254.cn: 赤明岛中有泉水沸腾，其味刺鼻，物掷其间，须臾则熟…

Desc_255.en: The earthen houses on Chiming Island are separated by ravines. An eternal molten lava surrounds its settlements...
Desc_255.cn: 赤明岛垒土屋，以沟壑隔人户，熔浆绕城仿佛流火不灭…

Desc_256.en: The lava in Chiming Island has flowed and churned into a pond, never solidifying. The locals call it the Flame Pond...
Desc_256.cn: 赤明岛熔浆汇于池中，流动翻腾，从不凝固，人称火池…

Desc_257.en: Formed into the crater of Chiming Island is the pattern of a Yellow Loong. Many have called it an act of the divine...
Desc_257.cn: 赤明岛火山口处，有状若金龙之地纹，人言其为神迹…

Desc_258.en: The Loong Palace stands at the Volcano crater. Adorned with images of the Yellow Loong, it's maintained by a garrison of servants...
Desc_258.cn: 金龙殿立于火山山口，殿内只摆满金龙，仆从时时擦拭…

Desc_259.en: During festivals, the Isle Master of Fuloong Sanctuary throws an idol of the Yellow Loong into the volcano to request protection from the True Loong...
Desc_259.cn: 至节日，伏龙坛岛主便以金龙掷火山中，以求真龙护佑…

Desc_260.en: A boom was once heard under Chiming Island, like the roar of a loong. What followed was a great earthquake...
Desc_260.cn: 赤明岛地底有轰然声，仿佛龙吟，又有地震，乃龙翻身…

Desc_261.en: The Sanguine Sect is secluded deep in the forest. When one enters the Sanguine Valley, they will often encounter leeches and sand lice...
Desc_261.cn: 血犼教地僻林深，入谷下上跻攀，常遇飞蛭、沙虱之物…

Desc_262.en: Mist of the Sanguine Valley is a blood crimson and highly poisonous. It's deadly enough to kill any creatures on contact...
Desc_262.cn: 血犼谷雾起赤红色。其红雾中含有剧毒，人兽触而死…

Desc_263.en: The entrance to the Sanguine Valley is a narrow squeeze. If one enters with a torch, they are sure to be met with a cloud of bats...
Desc_263.cn: 入血犼谷狭窄，犹如一线，持火把行，蝙蝠便扑炬而出…

Desc_264.en: The Sanguine Hall is built into rugged terrain. The dark beasts that guard the hall are known to spit fire and consume the flesh of men...
Desc_264.cn: 血犼殿山石嶙峋，殿首血犼喷火食人，最阴森诡异…

Desc_265.en: The Sanguine Sect has erected iron bars to imprison both man and beast alike. Their prisoners often fight amongst themselves for what food they can find...
Desc_265.cn: 血犼教置铁栏关押人畜，其中常见人畜争食，撕咬搏击…

Desc_266.en: In the Sanguine Valley one can find stone springs. On occasion, blood pierces through the stones like a thread, permeating a sickly smell across the area...
Desc_266.cn: 血犼谷有石孔为泉，偶有血水穿石如线，便腥气弥漫…

Desc_267.en: The crows often found circling above the Sanguine Sect have led to rumors of cannibalism...
Desc_267.cn: 血犼教上空常有乌鸦盘桓，或言人语，传言乃食人之故…
Desc_267.ru: Вороны, которых часто можно было встретить кружащими над Багряной сектой, породили слухи о каннибализме...

Desc_268.en: The Blood Pool is a restricted area of the Sanguine Sect. Legend has it that when one enters, they will gaze upon the visage of Xiangshu...
Desc_268.cn: 血池乃是血犼教之禁地，相传人入其中，便见相枢…

Desc_269.en: In the Sanguine Valley are beasts shaped like a scaled horse, they breathe fire capable of burning down entire forests...
Desc_269.cn: 血犼谷有色赤红，如马而有鳞者，口中喷火，焚谷烧林…

Desc_270.en: Listening to the Five Melodies of Mr. Cai, one can envision a peaceful spring, a rolling river, peaceful seclusion, the worries of life, and a longing for autumn...
Desc_270.cn: 听蔡氏五弄，便见春、观水、怀幽、生愁、思秋…

Desc_271.en: Music can affect the hearts of men. As evil music creates evil men, so too does righteous music create righteous men...
Desc_271.cn: 音乐可以影响人心，奸声使人恶，正声使人善…

Desc_272.en: Anger drowns out both gods and demons, hatred surges across the world. One feels within the song...
Desc_272.cn: 怒意滔滔淹鬼神，恨意滚滚没天地，闻曲如身在其中…
Desc_272.ru: Гнев заглушает как богов, так и демонов, ненависть захлестывает весь мир. Человек чувствует себя внутри песни...

Desc_273.en: The song of dance of the Tang Dynasty differs much from that of today. Vivid and romantic, its legacy has been passed down generations...
Desc_273.cn: 唐朝歌舞与此时歌舞不同，浪漫奇彩，博纳万家…

Desc_274.en: Reserved yet far-reaching, only those of lofty ambition and righteous conduct can truly appreciate "Secluded Orchid in Jieshi Mode"...
Desc_274.cn: 《碣石调·幽兰》声微而志远，非志洁行芳者无法领略…

Desc_275.en: When listening to the Guangling Folk Strains, one's heart feels bold and unrestrained, without a hint of sadness...
Desc_275.cn: 听闻广陵散，心中自生豪迈潇洒，又不觉悲来…

Desc_276.en: The song starts in an age of prosperity, but with the country shattered and its people suffering. It's long been seen as a bad omen...
Desc_276.cn: 盛世谱霓裳，曲终而国破、人散，人言其不祥之曲…

Desc_277.en: The Dunhuang Music Scores contain many ancient and long-lost musical techniques...
Desc_277.cn: 敦煌曲谱载录了许多古老、失传已久的音律与曲谱…
Desc_277.ru: Партитуры Дуньхуана содержат множество древних и давно утраченных музыкальных приемов...

Desc_278.en: The book contains the lost scores of the Yilan Cao and Canxing Cao, which are considered progenitors to music...
Desc_278.cn: 书载猗兰操、残形操等失传之乐谱，乃是琴音之始…

Desc_279.en: The book says: Do not chase victory. One must work in steps, with a heart clear as water...
Desc_279.cn: 书中言：不得贪胜。乃是步步为营，心如止水之理…
Desc_279.ru: В книге сказано: не гоняйся за победой. Нужно работать поэтапно, с сердцем, чистым, как вода...

Desc_280.en: Weiqi is a game of strategists. When one wins at Weiqi, so too shall they win the siege...
Desc_280.cn: 围棋之戏，乃属兵家之类。置棋围城，便是得胜…
Desc_280.ru: Вэйци - это игра стратегов. Когда кто-то победит при Вэйци, они выиграют и осаду...

Desc_281.en: Playing Weiqi involves the marching of armies, ingenious deceit, careful analysis, and acting when the time is right...
Desc_281.cn: 书中行棋如行军，以巧诈，以谨审，审时而度势…

Desc_282.en: The Weiqi Record of an Old Lady lies in the unexpected and transforming the teachings of old...
Desc_282.cn: 《媪妇谱》在于：出“棋”不意，先人一“手”…
Desc_282.ru: История старой леди Вэйци заключается в неожиданном и преобразующем учении древности...

Desc_283.en: The Essence of Weiqi, Momentum of Weiqi, and Sequence of Weiqi are considered the game's three great works. To master even one is enough to become invincible...
Desc_283.cn: 棋有三论：弈旨、弈势、棋品序，能悟其一，已称无敌…

Desc_284.en: The book contains the Liquan position, the five-cart position, and other amazing diagrams of Weiqi positions...
Desc_284.cn: 书中醴泉图及五车势等图谱棋势，先招后手，令人称奇…

Desc_285.en: Weiqi is won through vigorous planning and surprising the opponent. If one does not think about their moves, they are sure to lose...
Desc_285.cn: 棋势正合严谨，以奇诡而胜；不思而应，则必取败…

Desc_286.en: The book advocates for aggressive use of cannon pieces to create unlosable positions...
Desc_286.cn: 书中始用顺手炮、列手炮之战术，棋攻棋杀，从无败局…
Desc_286.ru: В книге пропагандируется агрессивное использование пушечных орудий для создания неприступных позиций...

Desc_287.en: According to legend, this is a game of the heavens. From ancient times to the present day, no one has been able to solve it...
Desc_287.cn: 相传此局乃天宫棋谱，古往今来，至今无人能解此局…

Desc_288.en: The book outlines the dwellings, implement, and food of the Tang Dynasty, which are quite different from what we have today...
Desc_288.cn: 书中载录唐朝居处、器物、服馔，与今日有所不同…

Desc_289.en: The writing of the book is catchy and easy enough for children to understand...
Desc_289.cn: 书中词句朗朗上口，黄口小儿亦能倒背如流…
Desc_289.ru: Написание книги запоминающееся и достаточно простое для понимания детьми...

Desc_290.en: The book includes the calligraphy of Shi Zhou, Li Si, Cai Yong, Wang Xizhi, and other masterworks...
Desc_290.cn: 书中将史籀、李斯、蔡邕、王羲之等人的书法列作神品…
Desc_290.ru: В книгу вошли каллиграфические работы Ши Чжоу, Ли Си, Цай Юна, Ван Сичжи и других мастеров...

Desc_291.en: The beautiful and unique style, along with the clear and easy flow of Zhao Gou's calligraphy made his works masterpieces of the Six Dynasties...
Desc_291.cn: 赵构清逸流宕，秀异而特立，可谓得六朝书法之大成…

Desc_292.en: The skill of a brushstroke lies in strength, momentum, and reservation. Mastering these two, one can adapt to different style methods...
Desc_292.cn: 运笔在于力、势、藏，知此三，便体法百变，也得灵韵…

Desc_293.en: The ballad has driven many to tears with its line "Still alive, they were parted as though by death, with grief and regret beyond description..."
Desc_293.cn: 众人闻书垂泪，无不辄叹：生人作死别，恨恨那可论…

Desc_294.en: Those who learn the regular script start with the word "Yong." This is how things are taught by the "Eight Principles of Yong"...
Desc_294.cn: 凡写楷书者，皆以永字为起笔，循“永”字八法而书…

Desc_295.en: The people of Tibet regard King Gesar as a great hero, and afford him much respect...
Desc_295.cn: 藏地百姓将格萨尔王视为旷世英雄，对其十分尊崇…
Desc_295.ru: Народ Тибета считает короля Гесера великим героем и оказывает ему большое уважение...

Desc_296.en: The book contains hundreds of poems, songs, and odes that have become known across the realm...
Desc_296.cn: 四字蔽此书：雅俗正集。音，情，歌尽于此三百篇中…
Desc_296.ru: Книга содержит сотни стихотворений, песен и од, которые стали известны по всей стране...

Desc_297.en: Even if you haven't seen the paintings within, the Song on Paintings has descriptions vivid enough to help one visualize them...
Desc_297.cn: 不见画作，但闻《图画歌》，便能知七分形象…

Desc_298.en: Huang Xiufu travelled all over Shu and visited many Stupas to compile his book...
Desc_298.cn: 黄休复为编撰此书，行遍蜀地，寻访了众多寺院…
Desc_298.ru: Хуан Сюфу путешествовал по всему Шу и посетил множество ступ, чтобы составить свою книгу...

Desc_299.en: The landscape paintings of today take heavily from this book. No one can escape its influence...
Desc_299.cn: 今时之山水画作，大都受此书影响，然无人能越其藩篱…
Desc_299.ru: Современные пейзажные картины во многом заимствованы из этой книги. Никто не может избежать его Влияния...

Desc_300.en: Before this piece, other paintings were nothing more than plums, orchids, bamboo, and chrysanthemum. After this piece, they were full of all kinds of life...
Desc_300.cn: 此画前，所绘无非梅兰竹菊，此画后，甫有生灵百态…

Desc_301.en: The book contains the records of many masters who, unknown in their time, are now renowned by all...
Desc_301.cn: 此书记载许多名家，当时不闻于世，如今已是众人皆知…
Desc_301.ru: Книга содержит записи многих мастеров, которые, неизвестные в свое время, сейчас известны всем...

Desc_302.en: The woman depicted in the book is upright in body and mind. Those who lay eyes on her dare not have a vicious idea...
Desc_302.cn: 书中所绘妇人，身心并正，人观之，不敢生亵渎之心…

Desc_303.en: When the palace halls of Tang were opened, dignitaries from across the world would travel to offer tribute. Such was the glory of Tang...
Desc_303.cn: 九天阊阖开宫殿,万国衣冠拜冕旒。唐之气魄具在此中…

Desc_304.en: Varied in style and full of detail, one can feel the human spirit seeping off the painting...
Desc_304.cn: 汴京百态，巨细无遗，人情风貌，宛如眼前…
Desc_304.ru: Разнообразная по стилю и насыщенная деталями, картина пропитана человеческим Духом...

Desc_305.en: The Goddess of the River Luo depicted in the painting is both magnificent and graceful... One sees not merely a painting, but rather goddess in the flesh...
Desc_305.cn: 画中洛神瑰姿艳逸，仪静体闲……非是图画，真乃洛神…

Desc_306.en: Our ancestors often used the Golden Divination Rhymes to tell their fortunes and affirm the true nature of past and present...
Desc_306.cn: 古人常以金口诀预测吉凶祸福，断言古今未来…

Desc_307.en: The fortunes told by this book are often realized...
Desc_307.cn: 以此书预测命数往来，或有应验者…
Desc_307.ru: Предсказания, о которых рассказывается в этой книге, часто сбываются...

Desc_308.en: There are 18 sets of Mysterious Gates and Escaping Technique, which can be used to move armies, and summon the aid of gods and demons...
Desc_308.cn: 奇门遁甲共十八局，可为行军布阵之用，则如神鬼襄助…

Desc_309.en: In the past, the Qintian Supervisor used Purple Star Astrology to read the destiny of their dynasties...
Desc_309.cn: 昔日钦天监以紫微斗数测王朝命数，已言到至今…

Desc_310.en: During the age of the Chanyu, constellation were considered to have risen and fallen with the fortunes of sons...
Desc_310.cn: 在单于之岁，岁星在子，会与虚、危二星宿共升共落…

Desc_311.en: The rise and fall of constellation, changes in the moon and stars... Such things are closely tied to the fortunes of nations and men...
Desc_311.cn: 星宿升落、日月变幻，皆与国运、人势息息相关…

Desc_312.en: The book is the beginning of the Five Elements and the creation of Jiuzhou. Reading the book is said to be a peek into heaven and earth...
Desc_312.cn: 此书谓五行之始，所创大小九州。言其为窥天探地之书…

Desc_313.en: Much like the descent of an immortal, the Yellow River Map and Lo Shu Square came to the world as an act of destiny...
Desc_313.cn: 时逢圣人，《河图洛书》乃出，人皆视其为天命瑞应…

Desc_314.en: The Book of Changes is known across households, and is primarily concerned with teaching people about the rituals and their fate...
Desc_314.cn: 《周易》广博，在乎教人明达知礼，在乎教人卜筮知命…

Desc_315.en: The beauty of tea lies not in the leaves, but in the water...
Desc_315.cn: 茶水之美，贵在于茶，更在于水…
Desc_315.ru: Красота чая заключается не в листьях, а в воде...

Desc_316.en: The book describes a village of liquor that one can only find by making any offering then crossing the mountains...
Desc_316.cn: 书中载有醉乡。献酒千钟，可借道姑射山，而至醉乡…

Desc_317.en: The book discusses tea kettles. Tea made from gold and silver kettles are called Fugui, those made from stone and jade are called Xiubi, and those made from copper and iron are called Chankou...
Desc_317.cn: 书中论汤器：金银称富贵，石琢称秀碧，铜铁称缠口…

Desc_318.en: The book describes tea as the first of all herbs; liquor as the nectar of nobility...
Desc_318.cn: 书中言茶：百草之首奉天子；言酒：玉酒琼浆通贵人…
Desc_318.ru: В книге чай описывается как первая из всех Трав; Вино - как благородный нектар...

Desc_319.en: The book ranks tea by color. Pure white is of the highest grade, followed by green and white, gray and white, then yellow and white...
Desc_319.cn: 书中论茶色，纯白为上，青白次，灰白次之，黄白又次…

Desc_320.en: To create liquor during the winter moon, brewers hold the urn tight to accelerate the process. This technique is known by a few...
Desc_320.cn: 冬月酿酒，便抱瓮而待，少顷既成。此法少于人知…

Desc_321.en: The book says that water is the most fair. Though it has its preferences, it cares not of the ranking...
Desc_321.cn: 书中言：水虽有喜恶，但无论次第。乃是最为公允…

Desc_322.en: Glutinous japonica is blended and mixed with flowers into a brick of fermentation starter, which is then used to make wine...
Desc_322.cn: 糯粳相糅，杂以花卉为饼，乃成曲，制酒而为精酿…

Desc_323.en: After sampling tea from far and wide, he came to the conclusion that Xiazhou and Gwangju made the best, while Yizhou and Youzhou made the worst...
Desc_323.cn: 其品评天下茶叶，言峡州、光州为上，易州、幽州为下…

Desc_324.en: The ornamentation was forged through careful hammering and engraving...
Desc_324.cn: 鼎身纹饰乃是以锤揲、錾刻之法雕刻而成…
Desc_324.ru: Орнамент был выкован с помощью тщательной ковки молотком и гравировки...

Desc_325.en: The location and texture of the ores are different, as are the types of wood and intensity of the fire...
Desc_325.cn: 矿石之所在、质地不同，所用木柴、火势也有差异…

Desc_326.en: The book contains more than 40 swords that once belonged to emperors and famous generals...
Desc_326.cn: 书中载录帝王、名将之刀剑四十余件，有其主之风…
Desc_326.ru: В книге собрано более 40 мечей, которые когда-то принадлежали императорам и знаменитым полководцам...

Desc_327.en: The book states that swords made of steel colored yellow and white are the highest quality...
Desc_327.cn: 书中言相剑：剑色黄白相杂，则坚牣，乃为良剑…
Desc_327.ru: В книге говорится, что мечи, изготовленные из стали желтого и белого цветов, отличаются высочайшим качеством...

Desc_328.en: There are hundreds of rivers throughout Jiuzhou. Those seeking the Longquan know it is at one of their ends...
Desc_328.cn: 九州有百条江河，其水可以铸龙泉，可循之而往…

Desc_329.en: The five swords of Goujian are hidden in the highest mountains, the deepest waters, and the darkest caverns...
Desc_329.cn: 越王五剑乃藏于山之高处、水至深处、地之低处…

Desc_330.en: Creation lies not just in Fine Arts, but also in time and place...
Desc_330.cn: 造物不仅在于技艺高低，更关乎天时、地利…
Desc_330.ru: Творчество связано не только с Ремеслом, но и со временем и местом...

Desc_331.en: Made from the tin of a mountain, the copper of a stream, then forged by great fire... One's sword is no less magical than the weapons of myth...
Desc_331.cn: 以山之锡，溪之铜，铸炉烈火所铸之剑，坚利堪比神兵…

Desc_332.en: One can melt jade and craft a sword together with copper and iron, which combines the strength of all three...
Desc_332.cn: 有火可以熔玉，与铜铁铸造，尽得玉、铜、铁之优…

Desc_333.en: With enough skill, even rotted wood can be carved into something greater...
Desc_333.cn: 朽木若以巧工，则皆可以雕琢…
Desc_333.ru: При достаточном мастерстве даже из сгнившего дерева можно вырезать нечто большее...

Desc_334.en: Whether for food, clothing, shelter, or transportation... All the flowers, plants, and trees of this world have their own uses...
Desc_334.cn: 世间花草林木，皆有用处，衣食住行，不可或缺…

Desc_335.en: After the Shang Dynasty, it became common to decorate carts with calligraphy and boats with carvings...
Desc_335.cn: 商朝以后，车饰文采，舟以刻镂，不仅牢固而已…

Desc_336.en: In addition to carpentry, the book contains much relevant to people's livelihoods...
Desc_336.cn: 书中所载不仅可以制木，亦能作用于民生…
Desc_336.ru: Помимо Столярного дела, в книге содержится многое, имеющее отношение к жизнеобеспечению людей...

Desc_337.en: The ingenious mechanism contained within has long amazed generations. With enough comprehension, perhaps it can be recreated...
Desc_337.cn: 其中机关巧制，令人称奇，若有悟性者，或可以再现…

Desc_338.en: Though the heavens can be measured, days are long and nights are short, ever-changing...
Desc_338.cn: 天圆地方，可以度量；昼长夜短，变化有常…
Desc_338.ru: Хотя небеса можно измерить, дни длинны, а ночи коротки и постоянно меняются...

Desc_339.en: The principles of the book are upright. The unique techniques contained within cannot be compared with the ordinary...
Desc_339.cn: 书中所载规制正大，少于奇淫技巧，非民间技艺可比…

Desc_340.en: The features of this world are mechanisms of the Earth. One cannot decipher such things if the time, place, or people do not align...
Desc_340.cn: 顺地势、天时所造机关，非天时、地利、人和不能破解…

Desc_341.en: The mortise and tenon structure can be tightly fastened. Regardless of room or furniture, the design is equally seamless...
Desc_341.cn: 榫卯结构，无论宫室、家具均可严密扣合，致天衣无缝…

Desc_342.en: One can read the Pulse Classic to understand the nature of disease...
Desc_342.ru: Можно прочитать классическую книгу "Пульс", чтобы понять природу болезни...

Desc_343.en: By mastering the Posthumous Works of Mr. Chu, one can eliminate minor ailments...
Desc_343.cn: 读《褚氏遗书》，可以除小疾…
Desc_343.ru: Овладев посмертными работами мистера Чу, можно избавиться от незначительных недугов...

Desc_344.en: Once one has read and understood the Eighty-One Difficult Issues, such matters will not seem difficult anymore...
Desc_344.cn: 知难而解其难，则其中所述八十一难，皆不谓难…

Desc_345.en: Those suffering from ailments will appreciate the accuracy of this book's prescriptions for a variety of different diseases...
Desc_345.cn: 凡有疾病者，皆可观此书对症下药，能解诸多杂症…

Desc_346.en: Treatment lies in seeking the root cause of a disease and eliminating it. If one cannot identify the root, the illness is sure to return...
Desc_346.cn: 治病在于求本，究病根而除之，方不再犯，否则无谓…

Desc_347.en: If Cao Cao had been willing to undergo the craniotomy, he may have lived yet...
Desc_347.cn: 昔日曹操若肯开颅，其病未尝不能治…
Desc_347.ru: Если бы Цао Цао согласился на трепанацию черепа, он, возможно, был бы еще жив...

Desc_348.en: The medical knowledge of the book, if used to serve the people, is sure to alleviate much suffering...
Desc_348.cn: 书中经方要略，若为黎民知行，足以拯济疾苦…

Desc_349.en: The book does not describe herbs, but rather serves as an indispensable guide for the cooking of medicines...
Desc_349.cn: 书中无凡草，烹药当论“君”，乃“不可缺之”…

Desc_350.en: Those who master and apply the wisdom of this book are sure to live for a hundred years...
Desc_350.cn: 知书而行者，终其天年，度百岁乃去…
Desc_350.ru: Те, кто овладеет мудростью этой книги и применит ее на практике, несомненно, проживут сто лет...

Desc_351.en: The mosquitoes that live in scorching areas are full of toxins. One needs a gown to enter their forests...
Desc_351.cn: 热瘴之地所生长蚊虫多有毒素，进林需着长衫…

Desc_352.en: The Classic on Poison speaks of a class of poisonous weed that grows in the south and is capable of killing any creature...
Desc_352.cn: 《毒经》中载有一类毒草，长于南方，人畜食而亡…

Desc_353.en: Though called the Washing Away of Wrongs, the knowledge on poisoning and detoxification contained within are of great use to poisoners...
Desc_353.cn: 虽称洗冤，但为使毒者善用，则作下毒、解毒诸法…

Desc_354.en: On Evil Substances contains all manner of incurable and deadly toxins...
Desc_354.cn: 邪物论中载有鸩毒、牵机，毒性猛烈，无药可救…
Desc_354.ru: On Evil Substances содержит всевозможные неизлечимые и смертельные токсины...

Desc_355.en: The poisons within are not designed to kill, but rather to fight fire with fire...
Desc_355.cn: 其中所载毒物不在于奇烈，而在于可以以毒攻毒…
Desc_355.ru: Яды внутри предназначены не для того, чтобы убивать, а скорее для того, чтобы бороться с огнем огнем...

Desc_356.en: When liquor and poison are in harmony, the result is chronic. When liquor and poison counteract, the result is highly toxic...
Desc_356.cn: 酒与毒物相生则柔，为慢性毒，相克则烈，为剧毒…

Desc_357.en: The book records a total of one hundred and twenty-five herbs. When used in the creation of medicines, they serve as adjuvants against poison...
Desc_357.cn: 书中载录一百二十五药材，作药中佐使，却是毒中君臣…

Desc_358.en: The acupuncture points outlined in the book should not be manipulated lightly. When abused, one could destroy the root of another's life and carry out a great evil...
Desc_358.cn: 书中所列穴位不可擅用，损坏真源，妄造杀孽…

Desc_359.en: The book contains knowledge of the incurable poisons of Yunnan, Guangnan, and Huainan...
Desc_359.cn: 书中载云南、广南、淮南之三类毒物为上等，毒无可解…
Desc_359.ru: Книга содержит сведения о неизлечимых ядах Юньнани, Гуаннани и Хуайнаня...

Desc_360.en: Hualuo weaving is a complicated affair. One weaver needs to man the jacquard, while another needs to man the shuttle...
Desc_360.cn: 花罗织造复杂，需一人提花，另一人投梭…

Desc_361.en: Lijin silk is vivid in color. The spinning, weaving, and dyeing processes of Jibei differ greatly from those of the Central Plains...
Desc_361.cn: 黎锦多取色丝、吉贝织造，纺、织、染均与中原不同…

Desc_362.en: Jade of azure... Flowers of persimmon... All sorts of colors can be used in material...
Desc_362.cn: 玉石，如空青，花草，如柿叶，凡有色者，皆可作采色…
Desc_362.ru: Лазурный Нефрит... Цветы хурмы... В материале могут быть использованы все виды цветов...

Desc_363.en: Silk is produced through a process that includes cocoon selection, cocoon cooking, silk reeling, and finally silk drying...
Desc_363.cn: 蚕丝制法为：选茧、煮茧、缫丝、晾丝…

Desc_364.en: Clothing of the Tang Dynasty had a wealth of shapes, colors, and patterns not limited to any one style...
Desc_364.cn: 唐时制衣不拘于形制、色彩、纹样，包罗南北万象…

Desc_365.en: Kesi tapestries are woven by passing through the warp and using shorts lengths of weft. The resulting effect is a light and clear pattern...
Desc_365.cn: 缂丝以通经断纬之法织造，承空观之如雕镂之像…

Desc_366.en: Dressing appropriately is a way to show respect...
Desc_366.cn: 衣冠循之有法，则举止行之有礼…
Desc_366.ru: Одеваться подобающим образом - это способ проявить уважение...

Desc_367.en: The embroidery of patterns is the most delicate part of weaving. One must maintain sharp, focused attention...
Desc_367.cn: 织花文锦乃织造最精细处，必要眼观入微，而机杼不断…

Desc_368.en: Lei Zu's sericulture techniques are renowned across the realm...
Desc_368.ru: Методы шелководства Лэй Цзу известны по всей стране...

Desc_369.en: Red sand can restrain nephrite; purple sand can overcome jadeite...
Desc_369.cn: 红砂者，可以克软玉；紫砂者，可以攻硬玉…
Desc_369.ru: Красный песок может сдерживать нефрит; фиолетовый песок может победить жадеит...

Desc_370.en: The ancients used six ceremonial jades, representing heaven, earth, the Azure Loong, the Vermilion Bird, the White Tiger, and the Black Tortoise...
Desc_370.cn: 古人以六瑞礼天、地、青龙、朱雀、白虎、玄武…

Desc_371.en: Though jade has beautiful qualities, without the application of skilled craftsmanship, it is no different from rubble...
Desc_371.cn: 玉虽有美质，在于石间，不值良工琢磨，与瓦砾不别…

Desc_372.en: Neither Guangxi agate, Sichuan jasper, nor all the jade in the world can compare to what's described in this book...
Desc_372.cn: 广西玛瑙，四川碧玉，诸天下玉石所集，莫过此书…

Desc_373.en: The gemstones come from Xiqiang and the Uyghur Khaganate. Those gemstones do not need to be carved and possess a natural beauty...
Desc_373.cn: 宝石出西番、回鹘，不复加磨拭，而得天真…

Desc_374.en: Skilled craftsmen will naturally stand out from the pack. When their time comes, they shine like gold...
Desc_374.cn: 手工巧者，自然颖异不凡，眼到手点，成金玉石也…

Desc_375.en: Once the edges and corners are removed from the mound, the shape of the vessel is completed. The material is as delicate as a hair...
Desc_375.cn: 砣之棱角既去，器形既成，其物纤巧如毫发…

Desc_376.en: Buried under the Sacred Tree for ten years then seeded with blood... This is how "living jade" is born...
Desc_376.cn: 玉埋建木之下十年，以血浇种，称是活玉…

Desc_377.en: The Queen Mother of the West bestows gold from the Lishui River and jade from Kunlun Mountain to those she favors...
Desc_377.cn: 金生丽水，玉出昆冈，西王母以赠人…

Desc_378.en: The five systems of the body revolve around the spleen, which serves as its center...
Desc_378.cn: 五脏以脾为主，乃是中央之穴…
Desc_378.ru: Пять систем организма вращаются вокруг селезенки, которая служит его центром...

Desc_379.en: The Tao is unobtainable, is ineffable, is unknowable...
Desc_379.cn: 道不可得，道不可言，道不可思…

Desc_380.en: Through tranquility, one can build character and good health; yet the meridians must flow freely also, and one's organs must be free of all ailments...
Desc_380.cn: 静漠恬澹，可以养性，而血脉无郁滞，五脏无蔚气…

Desc_381.en: When gold enters the fire, it achieves a form of immortality. The consumption of a golden elixir can protect one from aging and death...
Desc_381.cn: 黄金入火，毕天不朽，人服金丹，可不老不死…

Desc_382.en: When the world turns away from the Tao, calamity follows...
Desc_382.ru: Когда мир отворачивается от Дао, за этим следует бедствие...

Desc_383.en: Liezi, both noble and ineffable, mastered the imperial wind technique. He became capable of walking as the wind, much like a god...
Desc_383.cn: 列子贵虚尚玄，炼成御风术，可以御风而行，如若神人…

Desc_384.en: Heaven and earth surround me; I am one with all...
Desc_384.cn: 天地与我并生，而万物与我为一…
Desc_384.ru: Небо и земля окружают меня; я един со всем...

Desc_385.en: As all things are born of heaven, so too must all things return to heaven. This is the truth of the Tao...
Desc_385.cn: 天生万物，天杀万物，乃道之理…

Desc_386.en: From the Tao comes heaven and earth. It is the source of all things...
Desc_386.cn: 道为天地之本，万物之源…
Desc_386.ru: Из Дао происходят небо и земля. Это источник всего сущего...

Desc_387.en: If one recites the Heart Sutra often enough, they are sure to be blessed...
Desc_387.ru: Если человек достаточно часто повторяет Сутру сердца, он обязательно получит благословение...

Desc_388.en: Those who recite the Vajracchedika Sutra are sure to be rewarded for their devotion...
Desc_388.cn: 念诵《金刚经》，而有功德加持…
Desc_388.ru: Те, кто читает сутру Ваджраччхедика, обязательно будут вознаграждены за свою преданность...

Desc_389.en: Those that recite or hear the Ksitigarbha Sutra are washed clean of their sins...
Desc_389.cn: 念诵、闻说《地藏经》，消无量罪业…
Desc_389.ru: Те, кто читает или слушает сутру Кшитигарбхи, очищаются от своих грехов...

Desc_390.en: When one recites the Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters and remains pure in action, good is sure to follow...
Desc_390.cn: 时时念诵《四十二章经》，诸恶莫作，众善奉行…

Desc_391.en: When one recites the Three Canons of Pure Land, they shall be reborn in a paradise...
Desc_391.cn: 念诵《净土三经》，可使人往生极乐净土…
Desc_391.ru: Когда человек произносит Три канона Чистой Земли, он перерождается в раю...

Desc_392.en: When one holds to the precepts with devotion, all their desires are sure to be realized...
Desc_392.cn: 凡人持戒，而有功德，谓：凡所求者，辄得如愿…
Desc_392.ru: Когда человек с преданностью придерживается заповедей, все его желания обязательно сбудутся...

Desc_393.en: One can recite the Flower Garland Sutra to subdue monsters...
Desc_393.cn: 受持《华严经》功德，降伏诸妖魔…
Desc_393.ru: Можно читать сутру о цветочной гирлянде, чтобы усмирить монстров...

Desc_394.en: Listening to, writing, and guiding others in writing the Lotus Sutra is a show of immeasurable devotion...
Desc_394.cn: 闻说、自书、使人书《妙法莲华经》，所得无量功德…

Desc_395.en: By constantly reciting the Surangama Sutra, the Bodhisattva reaches Nirvana and achieves supreme enlightenment...
Desc_395.cn: 常持诵《楞严经》，证菩提涅槃，得无上正等正觉…

Desc_396.en: The food of Jiangnan is sweet, Qilu is salty, while Bashu is spicy...
Desc_396.cn: 江南好甜，齐鲁重咸，巴蜀喜辣…
Desc_396.ru: Еда в Цзяннани сладкая, Килу - соленая, а Башу - острая...

Desc_397.en: Scrub the inside and outside of the fish with mint, pepper, basil, and green onions to remove the fishy smell...
Desc_397.cn: 用薄荷、胡椒、紫苏、葱擦洗鱼内外，至极净，则除腥…

Desc_398.en: One can show their elegance by greeting guests with wild vegetables and the flowers and plants alongside streams...
Desc_398.cn: 以山野素菜，涧溪花草接待宾客，脱俗而有雅趣…

Desc_399.en: The sow in spring, plant in summer, harvest in autumn, and accumulate fertilizer in winter are the principles of agriculture...
Desc_399.cn: 春播种，夏插秧，秋收割，冬积肥，乃是农事道理…

Desc_400.en: Within this work is described a banquet so wondrous that one of its vegetable dishes is arranged to resemble a musical troupe. Carefully designed, their clothing so lifelike, it's like it's floating in the wind...
Desc_400.cn: 食单中一道素蒸音声部，所雕乐师衣袂飘飘，仿佛飞天…

Desc_401.en: The book contains a recipe for crab-stuffed orange. This dish features a wide palette of flavors, including wine, chrysanthemum, orange, and crab...
Desc_401.cn: 书中载蟹酿橙做法，其出有酒、菊、香橙、螃蟹之风味…

Desc_402.en: The techniques outlined in the Classic of Food can help preserve food and enhance flavor...
Desc_402.cn: 《食经》所列诸法，可以使食物不腐，更有味美…
Desc_402.ru: Приемы, описанные в "Классике Еды", могут помочь сохранить Еду и улучшить вкус...

Desc_403.en: This work describes the ways of the common people, going from an agricultural life to one spent brewing and fermenting...
Desc_403.cn: 书中说民生之计，起自耕农,终于醯醢…

Desc_404.en: The book contains many imperial dishes. Among them is "Sobering Kipper," which was a favorite of Emperor Wu...
Desc_404.cn: 书中载录御膳。其中有“醒酒鲭鲊”一方，为武帝所爱…

Desc_405.en: The bala is a ritual performed together by multiple generations, often at the end of the year...
Desc_405.cn: 八蜡，乃是三代之戏礼，人常于岁终聚戏…
Desc_405.ru: Бала - это ритуал, проводимый совместно несколькими поколениями, часто в конце года...
