Desc_406.en: Orchids, peonies, wintersweets, thimbleberry, and musk are considered Tier 1 among flowers...
Desc_406.cn: 花中一品：兰、牡丹、腊梅、酴醾、紫风流…
Desc_406.ru: Орхидеи, пионы, зимние сладости, черника и мускус считаются цветами первого Ранга...

Desc_407.en: Three thousand legendary swords were buried in the Tomb of Hulu, including the Slasher and the Yuchang...
Desc_407.cn: 阖闾墓中藏有三千柄名剑，扁诸与鱼肠便在其中…

Desc_408.en: It details how, in each corner of the land, people speak in ways quite unique; with phrasings entirely different to ours... These are known as dialects...
Desc_408.cn: 各地言语多有不同，其人曰蹶为动……乃是方言…

Desc_409.en: This world is vast, with mountains and seas extending far beyond the Western Regions and the Central Plains...
Desc_409.cn: 天地之大，非中原、西域等地，更有广博所在，曰山海…

Desc_410.en: The book outlines that to achieve success, one must weigh their options and always seek virtue over evil...
Desc_410.cn: 书中论人之制胜之道：权衡利害，趋吉避凶…

Desc_411.en: The Abstracts in Seven Categories of Books contains both Mohist and Confucian writings...
Desc_411.cn: 《七略》载录诸书总要，三墨八儒，皆当通读…
Desc_411.ru: Аннотации к семи категориям книг содержат как моистические, так и конфуцианские труды...

Desc_412.en: Mohists follow the teaching of the Mozi, which states that one should care equally for all other individuals...
Desc_412.cn: 兼士乃奉行墨家学说之人，其与人不分你我，感人所感…

Desc_413.en: The book contains block printing techniques that have become renowned across the realm...
Desc_413.cn: 书载刻板复印、磁石南指之术，脱颖于百行百业…
Desc_413.ru: В книге представлены методы печатания печатными буквами, которые стали известны во всем мире...

Desc_414.en: Most people there live at high altitudes in the shivering cold. They raise yaks to carry burdens and live on a diet of beef, mutton, milk, and barley...
Desc_414.cn: 人多居高寒处，以牦牛驼物，喜食牛、羊、奶、青稞…

Desc_415.en: Tsen' stands for powerful and 'Po' means man in their language. So they tend to call their emperors 'Tsenpo'...
Desc_415.cn: 俗谓雄强曰赞，丈夫曰普，吐蕃君长名中多含“赞普”…

Desc_416.en: They play Weiqi and make music with gongs and drums. Their emperor often makes friends with his subjects by building a relationship called Shared Life...
Desc_416.cn: 以棋、六博为戏，以螺、鼓为乐，君臣常相结为“共命”…

Desc_417.en: They have fine horse breeds. They ride these steeds in combat and wear iron armors protecting them from arrows and blades...
Desc_417.cn: 地产良马，人善骑马作战，铠胄裹身，强弓利刀不可伤…

Desc_418.en: They tend to intermarry with those of other countries. This is a sign of becoming allies, a union holding mutual benefits...
Desc_418.cn: 吐蕃常与他国通婚姻，若结姻亲，便是结盟互利之兆…

Desc_419.en: In the old days, each monk who took the vows would be supported by seven of their family. Today, monks are much more respected...
Desc_419.cn: 旧时一人出家为僧，七户平民供养，今时僧人亦受尊崇…

Desc_420.en: There were Seven Heavenly Tsenpos in their early history. These Tsenpos were believed to be the sons of God. They ruled the empire and then returned home by climbing the stairway to heaven...
Desc_420.cn: 古有天墀七王，乃天神之子，一统吐蕃后，随天梯返天…

Desc_421.en: They build statues of Buddhas with gold crowns and gemstones, sitting on thrones decorated with brocade and tassels...
Desc_421.cn: 佛像头戴金冠、饰宝石、坐锦缎，流苏覆于宝座之上…

Desc_422.en: There is a palace named Potala. People believe a path leading to a secret paradise lies hidden within one of the innumerable rooms there...
Desc_422.cn: 有宫殿名布达拉宫，通秘地乐园，其房间众多，难以计数…

Desc_423.en: Their lands produce Metals, Sandalwood, and Tulips. People there trade these products with other countries. And they harvest rice four times per year...
Desc_423.cn: 常与各国贸易，地产金刚、旃檀、郁金，稻谷一年四熟…

Desc_424.en: Men wear earlobe jewelry, while women wear beads of gold, silver, and pearls, and they all walk barefoot...
Desc_424.cn: 男子穿耳、佩耳珰，妇人戴金、银、珠缨络，皆喜赤足…

Desc_425.en: The Sindhu Empire rules vast stretches of land and is home to over a thousand cities. They have dozens of states under their banner offering tributes to the empire...
Desc_425.cn: 天竺幅员三万里，有城逾千，有附属国数十，四方来朝…

Desc_426.en: The people there will abandon wooden utensils after using them and will wash or polish metal ones over and over...
Desc_426.cn: 馔食时若用瓦木为器，经用必弃，金铁为器，必多洗磨…

Desc_427.en: There are many Buddhist relics within their lands. They all follow the way of the Buddha, vowing never to kill, nor drink...
Desc_427.cn: 国中有多处佛之故迹，国人崇尚佛法，不杀生、不饮酒…

Desc_428.en: In ancient India, one can find five-colored talking birds capable of reading one's thoughts. Some were once sent as gifts to the Central Plains in the Tang Dynasty...
Desc_428.cn: 国中有五色鸟，能说人语，通灵，唐时曾被赠予中原…

Desc_429.en: In the past, a skilled craftsman thrice saw the Maitreya in the heavens. He then carved wooden statues in his image...
Desc_429.cn: 昔有巧匠，三次去天上观弥勒菩萨真容，而后刻木作像…

Desc_430.en: It's said that there is a mage capable of using Seven-colored Water to attain immortality. And that he can conjure up storms out of thin air...
Desc_430.cn: 传言有人能以七彩之水，施不死之术，更能诵咒兴云雨…

Desc_431.en: A prince named Siddhartha awakened to understand the workings of the world under a bodhi tree. He founded Buddhism, taught people, and finally became the Shakyamuni Buddha...
Desc_431.cn: 王子悉达多于菩提树下悟道，传世人佛法，后成释迦佛…

Desc_432.en: Persia is known for its carpets, ceramics, wool fabrics, and flat-faced cats known as Persians...
Desc_432.cn: 波斯特产地毯、陶瓷、羊毛织物等，有扁脸猫名波斯猫…
Desc_432.ru: Персия известна своими коврами, керамикой, шерстяными тканями и плоскомордыми кошками, известными как персы...

Desc_433.en: The climate is hot and dry, so people use stored ice to relieve heat and channel water for irrigation...
Desc_433.cn: 气候暑热，家家藏冰解暑；土地干旱，民众引水灌溉…

Desc_434.en: The Persian emperor's family name sounds similar to that of the empire. He sits upon a golden sheep-shaped throne with his golden flower crown. His clothes are decorated with pearls and other relics...
Desc_434.cn: 波斯王姓波斯氏，坐金羊床，戴金花冠，衣饰珍珠宝物…

Desc_435.en: Persia has white elephants which warriors ride in combat. One elephant is accompanied by around a hundred soldiers...
Desc_435.cn: 波斯产白象，其民常乘象而战，一头大象可随战士百人…

Desc_436.en: The people of Persia practice Zoroastrianism. They are devoted to fire, light, and the sun...
Desc_436.cn: 此地民众多信仰琐罗亚斯德教，崇尚火、光明与太阳…
Desc_436.ru: Народ Персии исповедует зороастризм. Они посвящены огню, свету и солнцу...

Desc_437.en: Persia hosts many special performances including magic and flying shows, oh, and elephant shows, too...
Desc_437.cn: 波斯杂艺表演特异，有“魔术”、“飞天”，更有大象参演…

Desc_438.en: Their land contains salt lakes producing coral, amber, and pearls. But for them, these are merely common things...
Desc_438.cn: 地有咸池，中生珊瑚树、琥珀、珍珠，而国中不以为奇…

Desc_439.en: It's said that their gods help rule the realm if their emperor is wise enough. Their gods look much like rare animals...
Desc_439.cn: 传说若世有明君，神主便会显灵相助，神形如同鸟兽…

Desc_440.en: The sun and the moon are the eyes of their supreme god, Ahura, bringing illumination to the people. Ahura also gifts the people with inextinguishable fire...
Desc_440.cn: 至高神阿胡拉以日月为双目，予人光明，并赐不灭之火…

Desc_441.en: The Roman Empire comprised more than four hundred fortified towns. Its territory extends for thousands of miles. The Romans built their walls with white rocks...
Desc_441.cn: 大秦地方数千里，有四百余城，以石为城郭，石灰涂墙…

Desc_442.en: They have massive arenas that can fit a hundred thousand onlookers who gather to watch beasts and slaves fight...
Desc_442.cn: 有角斗场，容十万人围坐，观看猛兽和奴隶在场中搏斗…

Desc_443.en: The coral islands that grow in the sea are harvested by large ships casting iron nets...
Desc_443.cn: 海中有珊瑚洲，大船以铁网堕入水底，绞珊瑚根而出之…
Desc_443.ru: Коралловые острова, растущие в море, собирают большие корабли, забрасывающие их железными сетями...

Desc_444.en: They have buildings made of brick and stone. The brick domes are extremely tall, yet sturdy enough to not collapse...
Desc_444.cn: 诸多建筑以砖石筑成，众砖叠穹顶，尤绝高峻，竟不塌…

Desc_445.en: Summer in the Roman capital is swelteringly hot. They channel water into their houses and onto their roofs, letting it trickle down to cool themselves off...
Desc_445.cn: 都城盛暑嚣热，人引水上屋宇，四檐飞流，激气成凉风…

Desc_446.en: When doctors dissected monkeys to learn the location of their Zang-fu organs, they found that their bodies have a similar layout to that of us men. Ever since, some have likened monkeys to humans...
Desc_446.cn: 有医者解剖猴，见腑脏方位，类比于人，以为人猴相似…

Desc_447.en: Their people excel at carving stone. They often create lifelike statues of persons. Or make carvings to record events...
Desc_447.cn: 其人擅石雕，常以石雕人像，栩栩如生，或以石雕记事…

Desc_448.en: All the gods gather in the Pantheon. People believe they can communicate with Heaven through the oculus of the dome so that their souls can ascend...
Desc_448.cn: 万神殿众神集聚，人借穹顶圣孔与天沟通，灵魂自此升天…

Desc_449.en: Some claim that Earth is a sphere. And that travelers will return to their starting position as long as they keep traveling in one direction...
Desc_449.cn: 有人宣称大地如圆球，因此一路向西行，终可归原处…

Desc_450.en: They produce grape wine made of grapes and olive oil. People consider homing pigeons and olive branches as signs of peace...
Desc_450.cn: 地产葡萄酒、橄榄油，人以信鸽与橄榄枝为和平之证…

Desc_451.en: Their land contains city-states with various forms of government. Whether they are governed by autocracy or democracy, they exist together in peace...
Desc_451.cn: 城池林立却管制殊异，或以王权、或凭民声，自治相安…

Desc_452.en: Children belong to the state, which instructs them in morality and trains them in martial arts until they reach adulthood...
Desc_452.cn: 孩童属国所有，被统一教授道德、锻炼武艺，直至成人…

Desc_453.en: Dozens of their soldiers attacked Troy by hiding inside a wooden horse to sneak into the city. They were pivotal in the attack's success...
Desc_453.cn: 曾攻特洛伊，于木马中藏数十士兵，潜伏入城，征战而胜…

Desc_454.en: The people believe their gods can answer their prayers, and so they visit temples. The priests themselves consult the oracles...
Desc_454.cn: 人信神能解惑，于庙中求问，而祭司得神谕，代为作答…

Desc_455.en: There was once an enlightened man known as Socrates who taught virtue, wisdom, and courage and was respected by the people...
Desc_455.cn: 曾有圣人名苏格拉底，授民德、智、勇之道，世人敬之…

Desc_456.en: The Acropolis of Athens is a solemn place. It's extremely beautifully decorated, as if it was crafted by the gods...
Desc_456.cn: 有雅典卫城，众神庙极庄严，雕饰极美妙，如同神造…

Desc_457.en: Their gods live upon a sacred mountain, and also take the shapes of human beings. Each god has its own duties. They apparently also like to watch people competing in sports...
Desc_457.cn: 众神与人同形同性，居圣山上，各有司职，好凡人竞技…

Desc_458.en: There wasn't fire in the early days. A god stole fire and gave it to the people. But he got caught and was punished to be hung on a cliff while an eagle ate his liver...
Desc_458.cn: 世本无火，有天神为人盗火，后被罚于悬崖间受鹰啄食…

Desc_459.en: The land is well grazed and watered and produces strong horses. Its people enjoy hunting and archery over plowing the land, and often race on the ice while riding wooden sleds...
Desc_459.cn: 水草丰茂，善育良马，人嗜猎射、少耕获，常于冰上逐鹿…

Desc_460.en: Their men like gambling and women football. They often drink kumis, a kind of wine made from mare milk, while singing together...
Desc_460.cn: 民俗男子好博戏，女子喜踏鞠，饮马酪取醉，歌呼相对…

Desc_461.en: There was a leader named Ashina. The name means noble wolf. So people there worship wolves and carry banners featuring a wolf's head...
Desc_461.cn: 曾有首领阿史那氏，意高贵之狼，民俗崇狼，用狼头旗…

Desc_462.en: Their people often ride high-wheeled chariots. They are known as the Gaoche or Chile, though often erroneously called the Tölöš...
Desc_462.cn: 俗多乘高轮车，魏时亦号高车部，或曰敕勒，讹为铁勒…

Desc_463.en: They are good at smelting iron. Their families smelt and offered iron as a sacrifice to their ancestors on New Year's Eve...
Desc_463.cn: 其部族善冶铁，每岁除夕，家家炼铁于炉，以祭其先祖…

Desc_464.en: They live in the northern lands where the days are long and the nights short. If they begin to cook a lamb at sunset, the sun of another day will rise just as the lamb gets thoroughly cooked...
Desc_464.cn: 北地近日出处，昼长夜短，日落时烹羊，熟时东方已明…

Desc_465.en: If you see a flock of sandgrouse flying, know that Pallas's Sandgrouse is flying south and that barbarians are soon to come...
Desc_465.cn: 若见沙鸡群飞入塞，须知乃是突厥雀，南飞，胡人必来…

Desc_466.en: Apparently, there's the Kanggan River. Pines that fall into it grow along its waters, and within three years are molded into a solid stone, yet the grains of the wood can still be made out. They're known then as Kanggan stones...
Desc_466.cn: 有康干河，断松投之，三年化石，节理犹在，谓康干石…

Desc_467.en: Legends claim that one of their ancestors, Shemo, appears every day and descends into the sea at sunset led by a white deer...
Desc_467.cn: 传说其祖名射摩，每日暮，受白鹿接引入海，至明则出…

Desc_468.en: The men wear white robes and the women black gauze. with their clothing style, they show a preference for purity, hoping that this brings them good luck...
Desc_468.cn: 男子服白巾白袍，女子戴黑纱，以示素净圣洁，吉祥如意…

Desc_469.en: Their religion does not entail worshipping kings, nor do they distinguish between nobles and commoners. The consumption of pigs, dogs, horses, and donkeys is also prohibited...
Desc_469.cn: 有圣教，祀天时不拜国王，无问贵贱，肉不食猪狗驴马…

Desc_470.en: They place great in wisdom. They know gunpowder, papermaking, and mathematics and are willing to exchange books for gold of equal weight...
Desc_470.cn: 俗崇智慧，人知火药、造纸、数字，愿以等重黄金换书…

Desc_471.en: The climate there is hot and dry. So they make their roofs flat and sleep on beds placed atop their roofs...
Desc_471.cn: 气炎少雨，房舍屋顶平坦，人置床于屋顶，夜间睡其上…

Desc_472.en: There are rumors of a fragrant liquid. After mixing it with spirits, its aroma is slowly released and remains on their person for an extended period of time...
Desc_472.cn: 传言有香汁，香气缓释，可浸以烈酒，人沾之可时时芳香…

Desc_473.en: To reach the Central Plains, they must cross the seven seas, each with its own colors, tastes, fish, and styles...
Desc_473.cn: 若去中原，须横渡七海，色、味、鱼、风、物产各异…

Desc_474.en: A certain storybook is widespread in their land, containing hundreds of stories, stories enough for a person to tell one thousand and one nights...
Desc_474.cn: 民间传文集，有百千故事环环相扣，可讲述一千零一夜…

Desc_475.en: It's said that every seven days, those who die in battle shall be reincarnated in the heavens. These legends have inspired generations of loyal warriors...
Desc_475.cn: 每七日，王于礼堂说战死者将再生天上，于是民皆忠勇…

Desc_476.en: A legend there states that, in the western mountains, one can find three caves. Hidden deep inside is a weapon, and a black stone inscribed with white writings; he who retrieves both shall be crowned king...
Desc_476.cn: 有兽言：山之西有三洞，藏兵器、白字黑石，得者为王…

Desc_477.en: There are Great Snow Mountains whose snow melts into water and becomes rivers flowing through the lands. People rely on these rivers to make a living...
Desc_477.cn: 地有大雪山，其上雪水汇入河流，通达各部，民赖此生…

Desc_478.en: The people there are quite tall. they have golden hair and blue eyes. They carry weapons wherever they go and fight without fear...
Desc_478.cn: 其民身形颀长、金发碧眼，常随身持携兵刃，勇猛无畏…

Desc_479.en: They excel in carpentry. Their houses and weapons are made of wood and reinforced with other materials. They hardly use iron and other metals...
Desc_479.cn: 善制木，房舍、兵器均以木造，以他物加固，少用金铁…

Desc_480.en: They feel honored to fight for their lord and value national development more than their self-interests...
Desc_480.cn: 百姓不重私产，而以民族之存为贵、为主拼搏为荣…

Desc_481.en: They baptize their newborn babies with cold water in order to repel evil spirits and make them grow stronger...
Desc_481.cn: 凡婴儿初生，需用冰水洗礼，以淬其身骨，并驱除邪灵…

Desc_482.en: They see female priests as deities and worship them. And people daren't neglect their predictions...
Desc_482.cn: 时人崇尚女祭司，以为其具神性，若有预言，不敢轻视…
Desc_482.ru: Они видят в женщинах-жрецах божеств и поклоняются им. И люди не смеют пренебрегать своими предсказаниями...

Desc_483.en: Legends talk about a secret isle, an isle to which a goddess often rides heavenly horses. Yet, nobody dares to see what she looks like...
Desc_483.cn: 传闻海上有岛，有女神乘神驷往来，却无人敢窥其貌…

Desc_484.en: There is plenty of amber on their northern beaches. Nobody knows where it comes from...
Desc_484.cn: 有地名古顿，其海滩遍是琥珀，不知从何而生、从何而来…
Desc_484.ru: На их северных пляжах много янтаря. Никто не знает, откуда это берется...

Desc_485.en: After passing away, they will be buried together with their weapon. They believe this brings their souls back to the god of fate and grants immortality...
Desc_485.cn: 若人逝去，则以兵器殉葬，魂归于命运之神，而得永生…

Desc_486.en: Vikings live to the west. They are good at voyaging and fighting...
Desc_486.cn: 维京于西方，音似海湾、旅行，其民善于航海、战斗…
Desc_486.ru: Викинги живут на западе. Они хороши в путешествиях и сражениях...

Desc_487.en: They till the land as farmers and go out to sea after the harvest. During the winter, they settle down to maintain their tools. Thus, they keep busy throughout all the seasons...
Desc_487.cn: 百姓常农时播收，闲时出海，冬日修补工具，四时不闲…

Desc_488.en: Their ships are made of oak, giving the warships flexibility and resistance to wind and their cargo ships great capacity and sturdiness...
Desc_488.cn: 民好船，常取橡木制船，战船灵活抗风，货船高宽稳重…

Desc_489.en: They will create a passage if they come across land on their voyage. They will set guardians along the path and get the ship into the water again with manpower...
Desc_489.cn: 航行时若逢旱地，则开辟专道，设守卫，人力移船入河…

Desc_490.en: Their warriors hoist shields and create an unbreakable formation in battle. They call it a Shield Wall...
Desc_490.cn: 战时，众人持盾成阵，同进同退坚不可破，谓之盾墙…

Desc_491.en: Their poetry and legends are not recorded in writing but instead passed on through oral tradition in their winter lodges...
Desc_491.cn: 此地诗歌传说不以笔记，唯在冬日屋中经父辈口口相传…

Desc_492.en: They create ice skates by tying whale bones to the soles of their moccasins, allowing them to quickly traverse the harsh terrain...
Desc_492.cn: 冰鞋以鲸鱼骨作冰刀，绑于鹿皮鞋底，着之可疾行于冰面…

Desc_493.en: They have a god named Odin. He defeated countless giants with his spear and became the king of the gods...
Desc_493.cn: 有神奥丁，曾用长矛战胜无数巨人，遂为众神之首…

Desc_494.en: There are rumors of a mysterious island on which pirates from far and wide have buried their treasures...
Desc_494.cn: 传闻有神秘岛，曾有出海者聚金于岛上，藏于隐秘处…

Desc_495.en: There was once an unknown poison master in the Martial World who acted unscrupulously and created poisons without proper methods. He was eliminated by Taiwu before he could harm the world with his strange and deadly poisons...
Desc_495.cn: 江湖曾有一无名毒士行事无状，制毒无方，恐以怪毒诡药滥害世人，后遭太吾诛灭…

Desc_496.en: There was once an alchemist committed to crafting a highly peculiar poison and plaguing the world. But Taiwu saw through his plan and managed to convince him to pursue the path of goodness. One day, he had a revelation and attained immortality...
Desc_496.cn: 江湖曾有一无名毒士，欲制奇毒以戕害世人，然太吾识破，力劝改过，毒士深感其诚，从此归隐江湖，弃毒从善，一日倏尔悟道，逍遥而往，羽化登仙…

Desc_497.en: There was once a ghost lady wandering in an ancient tomb hidden in the depths of the Sanguine Valley. Upon hearing the bells of the successor of Taiwu, the ghost came back to life and fed on human flesh, spreading horror throughout the world...
Desc_497.cn: 曾有古墓深藏血犼谷中，墓中女鬼得太吾传人摇铃招魂，竟自黄泉苏生，降临世间，遍野食人，饮血啖骨，邪祟之气自此散布天地…

Desc_498.en: There was a Lord of Ghosts in an ancient tomb hidden in the depths of the Sanguine Valley. It came back to life upon hearing the Spirit-summoning Bell. The successor of Taiwu rose to the occasion and sealed the lord beneath the earth. And the Spirit-summoning Bell had never been seen thereafter...
Desc_498.cn: 曾有古墓深藏血犼谷中，因招魂铃响，墓中鬼王老祖竟自黄泉苏生，太吾传人为救世间，挺身将鬼王镇压封印地下，招魂铃亦自此不知所踪…

Desc_499.en: Shaolin Temple There had been a forest of Buddhist pagodas in the Shaolin temple, but a lot of them collapsed yet again and now lay in ruins. The eminent monk, however, had comprehended the Chan with the successor of Taiwu's help and decided not to restore them. The other monks at the temple also followed his lead and focused on their cultivation. And the Shaolin temple thus thrived...
Desc_499.cn: 少林寺中佛塔成林，近日再次大片倾倒，几近废墟，然寺中高僧受太吾传人点拨，了悟禅机，不再执着修塔之事，众僧自此愈发勤勉修行，佛法精进，少林一派终得昌盛…

Desc_500.en: With the successor of Taiwu's help, the monks of Shaolin finally found Bodhidharma's Sarira and built the Golden Pagoda, where they worshipped day and night. But the obsession with the statues led to the neglect of cultivation and finally, and Shaolin gradually fell...
Desc_500.cn: 因太吾传人相助，少林众僧终寻得达摩舍利，得以建成达摩金塔，供奉佛像，众僧终日朝奉礼拜，香火不断，盖因一心崇拜塑像，佛法修行竟因此荒废，少林一派，更是日益衰落…

Desc_501.en: The Ancestor of Wudang, one of the legendary generals of Zhenwu, descended to the world and discussed the matters of Tao with successor of Taiwu, arguing that the balance of Yin and Yang defines the Tao...
Desc_501.cn: 真武大帝座下神将，武当先祖，下凡遗世，传道解惑，与太吾传人论道，曰：一阴一阳谓之道…

Desc_502.en: The Ancestor of Wudang, one of the legendary generals of Zhenwu, descended to the world and discussed the matters of Tao with successor of Taiwu, arguing that the Tao is characterized by Yang ruling over Yin...
Desc_502.cn: 真武大帝座下神将，武当先祖，下凡遗世，传道解惑，与太吾传人论道，曰：阳盛阴衰谓之道…

Desc_503.en: It is rumored that the Jade-Maiden Sect had long pursued the secret of the Egarim but never attained enlightenment. Yet, with guidance from the successor of Taiwu, they finally grasped its mysteries, awakening to the essence of true emotions. From then on, they devoted themselves to love's sincerity, unwavering even unto death...
Desc_503.cn: 江湖言传，璇女一派虽钻研一明珏之秘已久，终未得道。却有太吾传人探得其中窍要，善加指点，竟令璇女得以顿悟奥妙，自此了悟人世之情，执求于情之真挚，至死不渝…

Desc_504.en: For over a century, no Jade-Maiden Sect disciple had ascended to immortality. The culprit, as unveiled by the successor of Taiwu, lay in the forbidden theft of the Egarim, which had stifled their cultivation. With this truth laid bare, the sect severed all worldly ties, and none dared transgress again...
Desc_504.cn: 百年以来，璇女无人登仙，原来皆因犯禁弟子夜盗一明珏灵玉，阻碍修为。太吾传人曾寻访此事，得知真相，璇女一派更是自绝情爱，此后亦再无弟子犯禁窃玉…

Desc_505.en: Rumor has it that the Yuanshan Sect once lost its way in demon-slaying. Fortunately, the Successor of Taiwu guided Yuanshan back to its original principles. Since then, the disciples of Yuanshan upheld righteousness, vowing to eradicate demons and defend the innocent, roaming the world as heroes of justice...
Desc_505.cn: 江湖言传，元山一派除魔无道，幸有太吾传人挺身而出，方才令元山弟子明悟元山初心，自此之后，元山弟子秉持护卫道义之心、斩妖除魔之志、普渡苍生之念，于世间行侠仗义，斩妖除魔…

Desc_506.en: Rumor has it that the Yuanshan Sect once lost its way in demon-slaying, resulting in a mighty demon breaking its seal and wrecking havoc upon the world. Fortunately, a Yuanshan disciple sacrificed their own life to seal the demon temporarily. However, the Yuanshan Sect became consumed by obsession, forgetting its original purpose...
Desc_506.cn: 江湖言传，元山一派除魔无道，竟令邪魔竟破开封印，霍乱人间，幸而有一名元山弟子不惜性命，挺身而出，暂且将那邪魔镇压！只是经此一事，元山一派终是执念过极，已然忘却元山初心…

Desc_507.en: The Lion-Face Clan obsessively pursued martial and scholarly perfection, neglecting their duties. Lei Kun, Hall Master of Flying Lion Hall, exploited this chaos. Thanks to the Successor of Taiwu, the Lion-Face Clan Leader repented in time, rallying disciples to crush rebel forces. Morale soared, and the Lion-Face Clan stood stronger than ever!
Desc_507.cn: 狮相门苦修文武双全之绝艺，夙夜匪懈，忘忽职守，致飞狮堂堂主雷坤借机生事，幸得太吾传人相助，令狮相门主幡然悔悟，率狮相门弟子痛歼胡贼，狮相门士气高涨！

Desc_508.en: The Lion-Face Clan obsessively pursued martial and scholarly perfection, neglecting their duties. Lei Kun, Hall Master of Flying Lion Hall, exploited this chaos. Though the Lion-Face Clan Leader repented in time and led his disciples to victory, the sect's spirit was left in shambles, its unity fractured...
Desc_508.cn: 狮相门苦修文武双全之绝艺，夙夜匪懈，忘忽职守，致飞狮堂堂主雷坤借机生事，狮相门主虽及时悔悟，率狮相门弟子痛歼胡贼，然狮相门终是士气萎顿，人心涣散…

Desc_509.en: The Vajra Sect had long sought enlightenment, yet true wisdom eluded them—until the successor of Taiwu introduced them to a Western Regions Eminent Monk. Under his guidance, they uncovered the long-lost sacred scriptures and mastered the Orthodox Learning. With the spread of their faith, local unrest subsided, and devotees flocked from afar to pay homage. The once-diminished Vajra Sect now flourished, the restoration of the Kingdom of Xang Xung's golden age on the horizon...
Desc_509.cn: 江湖言传，无量金刚宗潜心求佛，终得太吾传人引荐，拜会西域高僧，受其指点，求得宝经，将真传正法掌握手中。此后密宗佛法弘扬，当地民怨亦逐渐止息，凡有僧人、信众听闻此事，更不远千里赶往朝拜，金刚宗中一时间香火鼎盛，光复古象雄王国密宗伟业，从此指日可待…

Desc_510.en: Desperate to obtain the sacred scriptures, the Vajra Sect resorted to violence—abducting western monks and tormenting innocents. The Kunlun Mountains dwellers suffered greatly until the successor of Taiwu aided their escape. As fear spread, pilgrimages dwindled, and the Western Regions Eminent Monk vanished without a trace. The sect, lost in its own cruelty, watched as its teachings withered, its faith extinguished...
Desc_510.cn: 江湖言传，无量金刚宗久寻西域宝经而未果，竟是变本加厉，大肆搜捕西域僧人，残害当地无辜百姓。昆仑山居民不堪其苦，受太吾传人相助，纷纷举家而逃……为避此祸，往来僧人亦是日渐稀少，那传闻中的西域高僧更是杳无影踪，金刚宗恶行不止，乃至佛法荒废，香火日渐衰落断绝…

Desc_511.en: Ran Xindu, a Gu master, fell victim to her own deadly poison while practicing the Quintessence Heartbane. Aided by the successor of Taiwu, she uncovered ancient texts and realized that this path was doomed from the start. She thwarted the Divine Matron's schemes, guiding the Five Immortals Sect back to righteousness, where they embraced nature and honored spirits once more...
Desc_511.cn: 苗疆蛊仙苒心毒因修炼五圣心毒走火入魔，引致奇毒入体，苦受其害，后幸得太吾传人相助，寻得五仙遗稿，领悟其间奥义，知晓修习五圣心毒并非苗人出路，更阻止圣姑阴谋，令五仙教归邪返正，自此敬奉鬼神，尊爱自然…

Desc_512.en: Ran Xindu, consumed by the Quintessence Heartbane, deviated and suffered greatly despite uncovering the truth of her misguided path. The Divine Matron's machinations ensured her demise, and in the end, the sect's secret technique consummated...
Desc_512.cn: 苗疆蛊仙苒心毒因修炼五圣心毒走火入魔，引致奇毒入体，苦受其害，后虽因缘际会，寻得五仙遗稿，明悟其间奥义，知晓修习五圣心毒并非苗人出路，可终因圣姑设计铺谋，苒心毒魂消魄散，五仙众人秘术终成…

Desc_513.en: Ran Xindu, consumed by the Quintessence Heartbane, deviated and suffered greatly despite uncovering the truth of her misguided path aided by the successor of Taiwu. The Divine Matron's machinations ensured her demise, and in the end, the sect's secret technique consummated...
Desc_513.cn: 苗疆蛊仙苒心毒因修炼五圣心毒走火入魔，引致奇毒入体，苦受其害，后虽得太吾传人相助，寻得五仙遗稿，领悟其间奥义，知晓修习五圣心毒并非苗人出路，可终因圣姑设计铺谋，苒心毒魂消魄散，五仙众人秘术终成…

Desc_514.en: Word in the martial world tells of a demonic beast wreaking havoc on Mt. Emei, not only killing lives but also breaking into the sect to steal the founder's manual. With the help of the Successor of Taiwu, the Emei Sect finally slays it, only to find that the century-old founder's manual is nothing but the founder's idle scribbles. The true essence of the Emei Sect's founder's martial arts is thus lost to the ages, known to none...
Desc_514.cn: 江湖言传，峨眉山中忽有恶妖为祸，非但杀生害命，更闯入峨眉欲夺祖师秘籍。峨眉一派得太吾传人襄助，终于将其诛杀，只是那传世百年的祖师秘籍，竟不过是祖师昔年信手涂鸦，峨眉祖师之功法真谛，终究就此失传，再无人能知晓…

Desc_515.en: Word in the martial world tells of a demonic beast wreaking havoc on Mt. Emei, not only killing lives but also breaking into the sect to steal the founder's manual. With the help of the Successor of Taiwu, the Emei Sect slays it, and further enlightened by the Successor of Taiwu, they finally grasp the true meaning of the founder's manual. Henceforth, all disciples follow their hearts with ease in their cultivation, bringing peace and prosperity to Mt. Emei...
Desc_515.cn: 江湖言传，峨眉山中忽有恶妖为祸，非但杀生害命，更闯入峨眉欲夺祖师秘籍。峨眉一派得太吾传人襄助，将其诛杀，又蒙太吾传人点拨，终于了悟祖师秘籍真意，此后满门弟子心随意动，修行自若，更令峨眉山间太平安宁，一派欣欣向荣…

Desc_516.en: For centuries, two factions within Veil Scar Sect have been locked in shadow strife between the Malevolence and the Benevolence; outsiders dare not glimpse their secrets. When celestial patterns grew peculiar, azure flames erupted skyward from the Demise Abyss—whispers claim brutal conflicts among fellow disciples, leaving scores of fallen and wounded. Since that time, the stars of both the Benevolence and the Malevolence, along with the Qisha Star, have all concealed themselves beyond the firmament...
Desc_516.cn: 数百年来，界青门内追随万恶、万善两位祖师的两派暗斗不息，外人莫窥其详。及至星象异变，无生渊上青焰冲霄，传闻同门血战，死伤枕藉。自此万善、万恶二祖之星，并那南斗七杀一星，俱隐于穹苍之外…

Desc_517.en: Rumors abound of the long-standing feud between Veil Scar Sect's two ancestors; their disciples cling to their respective factions, and the fratricidal strife among them is countless. Thankfully, the Successor of Taiwu intervened, finally ending centuries of enmity between the two ancestors. The true authority within Veil Scar Sect now belongs to its devoted pupils, thus quelling that pointless conflict...
Desc_517.cn: 江湖传言，界青门两位祖师的纷争由来已久，门人各自依附一方，同门相残难以计数。幸得太吾传人介入其中，方才终结了两位祖师数百年的恩怨。界青门的实权最终归于门下众弟子，无谓之争由此消弭…

Desc_518.en: The grand Tri-School Contest took place within Ranshan Sect, one filled with twists and turns. Afterward, a mere child claimed to have received the teachings of both the successor of Taiwu and Master Wang Chan. With this newfound wisdom, the sect embraced a four-word doctrine, leading disciples toward deeper enlightenment...
Desc_518.cn: 江湖言传，然山派中举办了一场空前绝后、变故横生的三宗比武，而于此之后，门中一五尺小童忽然自称得了太吾传人与王禅祖师真传，悟出四字宗旨，如今然山派中，门中弟子皆凭此四字宗旨先后悟得玄门妙法，问道求仙之事从此更得精益…

Desc_519.en: The grand Tri-School Contest took place within Ranshan Sect, one filled with twists and turns, yet no one attained true enlightenment or divine guidance. Their pursuit of immortality became an aimless drift, lost in obscurity...
Desc_519.cn: 江湖言传，然山派中举办了一场空前绝后、变故横生的三宗比武，可于此期间，门中上下竟无一人行满功成，得遇仙缘，继而明辨仙家事宜，然山问仙求道之事，自此以后便是如坐云雾、如堕烟海…

Desc_520.en: According to investigations, within the mound resides an incarnation of Wood Qi. It strikes with the fury of the tempest, is immune to all poisons, and knows no respite in its assault...
Desc_520.cn: 据探查，冢中化身为紫霞内力，有百毒不侵之体，其攻势连绵不绝，有如疾风骤雨…

Desc_521.en: According to investigations, within the mound resides an incarnation of Metal Qi. It strikes with unparalleled ferocity, excels in physical martial arts, and cuts down all before it...
Desc_521.cn: 据探查，冢中化身为金刚内力，其招式刚猛无匹，尤以外功见长，剑锋所至，无不披靡…

Desc_522.en: According to investigations, within the mound resides an incarnation of Water Qi. Those caught in its frigid grip will find their movements slowed, their spirit drained, as if falling into an abyss of ice...
Desc_522.cn: 据探查，冢中化身为玄阴内力，若遭其寒气裹挟，定然行动迟滞，气势衰竭，如堕万丈冰窟…

Desc_523.en: According to investigations, within the mound resides an incarnation of Fire Qi. Those who tarry too long in battle with it, allowing it to soar to the heavens, will find themselves left far behind...
Desc_523.cn: 据探查，冢中化身为纯阳内力，若与之周旋过久，待其翱翔九天之时，便是望尘莫及…

Desc_524.en: According to investigation, within the mound resides an incarnation of Hunyuan Qi. Its techniques are dreamlike and illusory, capable of shaking the mind and throwing one's own moves into disarray...
Desc_524.cn: 据探查，冢中化身为混元内力，其功法如梦似幻，可使人心神动摇，招式自乱…

Desc_525.en: According to investigations, within the mound resides an incarnation of Hunyuan Qi. Its sinews and bones are as solid as rock. Even when covered in wounds, it can slowly heal itself...
Desc_525.cn: 据探查，冢中化身为混元内力，其筋骨坚如磐石，纵使遍体鳞伤，亦可缓缓自愈…

Desc_526.en: According to investigations, within the mound resides an incarnation of Hunyuan Qi. Its form flickers and shifts unpredictably, often leaving its opponent grasping at thin air, unable to trace its whereabouts...
Desc_526.cn: 据探查，冢中化身为混元内力，其身形飘忽不定，往往令对手如水中捉月，难测踪影…

Desc_527.en: According to investigations, within the mound resides an incarnation of Earth Qi. Its techniques are vicious and ruthless. The more grievously it is wounded, the more fiercely it fights...
Desc_527.cn: 据探查，冢中化身为归元内力，其招式凶残狠戾，重伤之下，反是愈战愈勇…

Desc_528.en: According to investigations, within the mound resides an incarnation of Hunyuan Qi. It excels at turning an opponent's strength against them. Attack it recklessly, and the balance of Yin and Yang will be disrupted. You will be consumed by your own force..
Desc_528.cn: 据探查，冢中化身为混元内力，尤擅借力打力，若是贸然攻取，阴阳失序，定将身遭反噬…

Desc_529.en: Monu Weave was surrounded by countless birds. Within the mound rested an Extraordinary named Monu, immune to all poisons and capable of conversing with avian creatures. Driven by a Sword Returning obsession, she ultimately deviated. Upon the successor of Taiwu unsealing Monu Sword, she dissolved into ethereal smoke, and the strange phenomena dissipated...
Desc_529.cn: “莫女衣”四周群鸟环绕，冢内有一异人，名唤莫女，百毒莫侵，能通禽鸟之语。莫女为还剑之愿所执，终入魔道，直至太吾传人解封“莫女衣”，遂作青烟散于天际，此地异象亦恢复如常…

Desc_530.en: Spiritsealer was enshrouded in a sinister aura. Within the mound rested an Extraordinary named Dayue Yaochang—towering like a demon-quelling mountain, unyielding as a pillar of the underworld. With a heart devoted to eradicating evil, he ultimately deviated. Upon the successor of Taiwu unsealing Spiritsealer, he planted his sword into the ground and turned to stone, and the ominous aura dissipated...
Desc_530.cn: “伏邪铁”四周煞气笼罩，冢内有一异人，名唤大岳瑶常，形容魁伟，状如伏邪之山，镇狱之柱。大岳瑶常为除魔之愿所执，终入魔道，直至太吾传人解封“伏邪铁”，遂拄剑于地，身化石像，此地异象亦恢复如常…

Desc_531.en: The "Dark Frost" exudes a bone-chilling cold, and within the mound lingers an Extraordinary called Jiu Han. Gaunt in appearance, he wields the Iceheart Blast to summon frost and shape snow. Trapped by worldly prejudice, he ultimately deviated. Only when the successor of Taiwu unsealed the "Dark Frost" did he vanish into the drifting snow, restoring the land to its former state...
Desc_531.cn: “大玄凝”之中极寒彻骨，冢内有一异人，名唤九寒，形容枯槁，能引奇寒灵气，凝冰塑雪。九寒困于世人之见，终入魔道，直至太吾传人解封“大玄凝”，遂消散于风雪之中，此地异象亦恢复如常…

Desc_532.en: The "Fenghuang Cocoon" radiates a dazzling golden light, and within the mound resides an Extraordinary called Jin Huang'er . Adorned in intricate patterns, her presence resembles that of a celestial Fenghuang. In her relentless search for a saint, she ultimately deviated. Only when the successor of Taiwu unsealed the "Fenghuang Cocoon" did she offer a final toast before vanishing without a trace, restoring the land's normalcy...
Desc_532.cn: “凤凰茧”之中金光夺目，冢内有一异人，名唤金凰儿，身披纹彩，貌若鸾凤，举动皆似神鸟下凡。金凰儿苦寻圣人而不得，终入魔道，直至太吾传人解封“凤凰茧”，遂倾赠杯中酒，就此隐没无踪，此地异象亦恢复如常…

Desc_533.en: Surrounding the "Ignideus Blaze," peach blossoms glow with spectral flames, and within the mound resides an Extraordinary called Yi Yihou, clad in burning robes, his expression one of sorrow, as if tormented by a grief that sears the soul. Mourning the one he loved, consumed by despair, he ultimately deviated. Only when the successor of Taiwu unsealed the "Ignideus Blaze" did he scatter into the wind like drifting petals, and the land was restored...
Desc_533.cn: “焚神炼”四周桃林幽火，冢内有一异人，名唤衣以侯，衣衫燃火，神情凄楚，若有焚心之悲。衣以侯追思所爱，苦痛难当，终入魔道，直至太吾传人解封“焚神炼”，遂作飞花随风散去，此地异象亦恢复如常…

Desc_534.en: "Candelor's Tail" is paved with bones. Within the mound resides an Extraordinary named Wei Qi, unkempt and disheveled, sparing no effort in pursuit of the Tao. Yet, having sacrificed his very life in vain, he fell into deviation. Only when the successor of Taiwu unsealed the "Candelor's Tail" did he seem to gain enlightenment, dissolving into the mire, restoring balance to the land...
Desc_534.cn: “解龙魄”乃是骸骨铺就，冢内有一异人，名唤卫起，蓬首垢面，不惜一切以求大道。卫起舍命求道而不得，终入魔道，直至太吾传人解封“解龙魄”，似有所悟，遂消融于污泥之中，此地异象亦恢复如常…

Desc_535.en: "Vitalos" was sculpted from jade. Within the mound dwells an Extraordinary named Yi Xiang, fair of face, youthful in form, and master of jade refinement. Yet, bound by his relentless pursuit of flawlessness, he strayed into deviation. Only when the successor of Taiwu unsealed "Vitalos" did he scatter into countless jade beads, restoring the land to its former peace...
Desc_535.cn: “溶尘隐”乃是玉石雕成，冢内有一异人，名唤以向，容貌清秀，形若少年，善为养玉之法。以向为无瑕之念所执，终入魔道，直至太吾传人解封“溶尘隐”，遂散作无数玉珠，此地异象亦恢复如常…

Desc_536.en: "Demonbind" stands amidst a sea of crimson maples. Within the mound resides an Extraordinary named The Blood Maple, his head crowned with sharp horns, his battle spirit unyielding through countless wars. Yet, in his quest to bring order to the world, he fell into deviation. Only when the successor of Taiwu unsealed the "Demonbind" did he shatter like a broken bough, and the land was restored to tranquility...
Desc_536.cn: “囚魔木”四周枫林尽赤，冢内有一异人，名唤血枫，头生利角，历千百战而杀意不减。血枫欲平天下而未成，终入魔道，直至太吾传人解封“囚魔木”，遂作枫木断折于地，此地异象亦恢复如常…

Desc_537.en: Above "Rainbow Ultima," the sun and moon flicker in a dance of shadows. Within the mound resides an Extraordinary named Spellwright, a master of arcane arts, skilled in weaving light and mist. Yet, trapped between duty and sentiment, she fell into deviation. Only when the successor of Taiwu unsealed the "Rainbow Ultima" did she ride the wind and vanish into the skies, leaving the land at peace once more...
Desc_537.cn: “鬼神霞”上空日月斑驳，冢内有一异人，名唤术方，道法神通，尤善采霞布虹。术方困于恩义难全，终入魔道，直至太吾传人解封“鬼神霞”，遂乘云而去，此地异象亦恢复如常…

Desc_538.en: Monu Weave was surrounded by countless birds. Within the mound rested an Extraordinary named Monu, immune to all poisons and capable of conversing with avian creatures. Driven by a Sword Returning obsession, she ultimately deviated. Upon the successor of Taiwu unsealing Monu Sword, she dissolved into ethereal smoke, and the strange phenomena dissipated...

Desc_547.en: During the Madness Calamity, the successor of Taiwu was the first to uncover faint clues. Inspired by this discovery, the disciples of Valley of Flowers joined forces in their investigations, and even two of their seclusive Masters emerged to subdue the demons. Yet, perhaps disheartened by the futility of their efforts, the two Masters chose to retreat from the world once more...
Desc_547.cn: 疯症之役中，太吾传人率先探得蛛丝马迹，百花谷上下受此鼓舞，齐心查探，更有二位祖师出山共降妖魔，可惜或许是济世无望，事情了结之后，二位祖师仍是退隐江湖了…

Desc_548.en: During the Madness Calamity, the successor of Taiwu joined the two founders of Valley of Flowers' to subdue demons. Moved by their shared ideals, the reclusive founders emerged anew...
Desc_548.cn: 疯症之役中，太吾传人与百花谷二位祖师共降妖魔，结下情谊，或许是受太吾救世之义的打动，二位祖师再度出山…

Desc_549.en: Rumor has it that on Chiming Island good omens once appeared, prompting the Fuloong Sanctuary to hold grand sacrificial ceremonies. Under the successor of Taiwu's guidance, they glimpsed a sign of the True Loong—but the creature soon abandoned them, soaring away. In despair the sect plunged into chaos, with no future on the horizon...
Desc_549.cn: 江湖言传，赤明岛上曾有祥瑞显现，伏龙坛大兴祭祀，此后又受太吾传人指点，终于得见真龙神迹，窥见真龙正身。然而真龙却弃伏龙坛不顾，转眼腾飞而去，伏龙坛自此万念俱灭，人心混乱，不知今后何去何从…

Desc_550.en: A tale tells of a natural disaster when a demon, disguised as a True Loong, descended upon the Chiming Island. The successor of Taiwu, passing through, exposed the fiend's true face and helped purge traitors from the Fuloong Sanctuary. Awakening at last to the truth that no True Loong ever graced the world, the sect repented its blind faith and rededicated itself with renewed resolve...
Desc_550.cn: 江湖言传，赤明岛上曾有天灾降临，妖魔假扮真龙现身，太吾传人途径此地，不仅出手助伏龙坛斩除内奸，更窥破妖魔真身，彻底将其击退。伏龙坛受太吾传人点拨，终于醒悟真龙并未降世，悔过从前盲信恶鸟时的种种不智之举，此后越发励精图治，心志更坚…

Desc_551.en: An Extraordinary from the "Monu Weave" Mound was defeated by the Successor of Taiwu and turned into wisps of smoke, returning to the Sword Mound. In the Sword Mound, the Extraordinary can unleash their full power, greatly boosting Follow-up attacks, Poisoning, and their ability of reducing Stamina and Inhale & Stance ...
Desc_551.cn: 有一异人自“莫女衣”破冢而出，为太吾传人所败，散作轻烟归于剑冢。当此异人于剑冢内全力以赴时，则其追击能力将大幅强化，造成的毒害将大幅提高，消除气势脚力的能力亦将提高…

Desc_552.en: An Extraordinary from the "Spiritsealer" mound was defeated by the Successor of Taiwu and turned into wisps of smoke, returning to the Sword Mound. In the Sword Mound, the Extraordinary can unleash their full power, their attacks can Interrupt Martial Arts, cause more Inhale & Stance consumption, and the Divine Arts deal more damage...
Desc_552.cn: 有一异人自“伏邪铁”破冢而出，为太吾传人所败，散作轻烟归于剑冢。当此异人于剑冢内全力以赴时，则其攻击可打断功法施展，对气势脚力损耗提高，神力可造成更多伤害…

Desc_553.en: An Extraordinary from the "Dark Frost" mound was defeated by the Successor of Taiwu and turned into wisps of smoke, returning to the Sword Mound. In the Sword Mound, the Extraordinary can unleash their full power, their movement-hindering ability is increased while your Stance and Stamina recovery speed are significantly reduced in their attack range. Moreover, their capability of influencing weapon attacks is also enhanced, allowing specific Divine Arts to seal more acupoints continuously...
Desc_553.cn: 有一异人自“大玄凝”破冢而出，为太吾传人所败，散作轻烟归于剑冢。当此异人于剑冢内全力以赴时，则其攻击范围内架势、体力恢复速度大幅降低，不仅阻止移动能力提高，影响武器攻击的能力亦是增强，特定神力可持续造成更多封穴…

Desc_554.en: An Extraordinary from the "Fenghuang Cocoon" mound was defeated by the Successor of Taiwu and turned into wisps of smoke, returning to the Sword Mound. In the Sword Mound, the Extraordinary can unleash their full power, their True Qi grows continuously; when all their True Qi exceed those of the Successor of Taiwu, they will then be immune to damage, and some of their specific Divine arts can sustainably cause more Openings on Taiwu...
Desc_554.cn: 有一异人自“凤凰茧”破家而出，为太吾传人所败，散作轻烟归于剑家。当此异人于剑家内全力以赴时，则其真气持续增加，全部真气皆超过太吾传人后遂免受伤害，其特定神力更可持续造成更多破绽…

Desc_555.en: An Extraordinary from the "Ignideus Blaze" mound was defeated by the Successor of Taiwu and turned into wisps of smoke, returning to the Sword Mound. In the Sword Mound, the Extraordinary can unleash their full power; they will cause more Technique Charge disruption and can inflict massive damage on those with less Charge, causing damage to more parts of the enemy simultaneously...
Desc_555.cn: 有一异人自“焚神炼”破冢而出，为太吾传人所败，散作轻烟归于剑冢。当此异人于剑冢内全力以赴时，则其不但破坏蓄式能力提高，更可对式少于其之人造成大量伤害，对敌更多部位同时造成伤害…

Desc_556.en: An Extraordinary from the "Candelor's Tail" mound was defeated by the Successor of Taiwu and turned into wisps of smoke, returning to the Sword Mound. In the Sword Mound, the Extraordinary can unleash their full power; their internal and external injuries fade over time and they gain increased might, no longer negating damage but instead causing more damage...
Desc_556.cn: 有一异人自“解龙魄”破冢而出，为太吾传人所败，散作轻烟归于剑冢。当此异人于剑冢内全力以赴时，则其内外伤势随时间而消，提高自身威力，不再抵消伤害而转为造成更多伤害…

Desc_557.en: An Extraordinary from the "Vitalos" mound was defeated by the Successor of Taiwu and turned into wisps of smoke, returning to the Sword Mound. In the Sword Mound, the Extraordinary can unleash their full power; their dispelling ability increased based on their Footwork, and some of their Divine Arts can seal more acupoints continuously...
Desc_557.cn: 有一异人自“溶尘隐”破冢而出，为太吾传人所败，散作轻烟归于剑冢。当此异人于剑冢内全力以赴时，则其可凭借自身剩余脚力提高自身化解，特定神力可持续造成更多的封穴…

Desc_558.en: An Extraordinary from the "Demonbind" mound was defeated by the Successor of Taiwu and turned into wisps of smoke, returning to the Sword Mound. In the Sword Mound, the Extraordinary can unleash their full power; their damage dealt is greatly increased, damage received is greatly reduced, and some of their Divine arts can be continuously cast without cost after dealing massive damage...
Desc_558.cn: 有一异人自“囚魔木”破冢而出，为太吾传人所败，散作轻烟归于剑冢。当此异人于剑冢内全力以赴时，则其造成伤害大幅提高，受到伤害大幅降低，其特定神力在造成大量伤害后可连续无消耗施展…

Desc_559.en: An Extraordinary from the "Rainbow Ultima" mound was defeated by the Successor of Taiwu and turned into wisps of smoke, returning to the Sword Mound. In the Sword Mound, the Extraordinary can unleash their full power; they can reflect attacks with a large difference between Internal Injury and External Injury, sealing more Martial Arts for longer periods...
Desc_559.cn: 有一异人自“鬼神霞”破冢而出，为太吾传人所败，散作轻烟归于剑冢。当此异人于剑冢内全力以赴时，则其可反震内伤与外伤差距较大的攻势，封禁更多功法更长时间…

Desc_560.en: For want of proper management, the Swordsmith Villa was forced to auction its famed swords, mechanisms, ancient bronzes, and Fine Arts Books to seven guilds—thus a millennium-long legacy was severed...
Desc_560.cn: 铸剑山庄因经营不利，被迫将庄中名剑机关、青铜古董、技艺书籍分售七大商会，山庄千年传承亦自此断绝…

Desc_561.en: Swordsmith Villa disciples cast off their obsession with celestial weapons and, embracing human skill instead, imparted all their craft and wisdom to the next generation. In doing so, the ancient legacy lives on...
Desc_561.cn: 铸剑山庄弟子抛去神兵执念，以人为器，将手艺、智巧、学识倾囊相授，千年传承方才得以延续…

Desc_562.en: In the deep, secluded wilds, the Mountain Dweller enjoys quiet harmony. Though unaware of the world beyond, they know the language of mountains and streams—tilling the clouds in the north and fishing the moonlit creeks in the south. While the wilderness holds hidden marvels, its dangers are few for those who have mastered its ways...
Desc_562.cn: 山人居于深山穷林，野客樵歌，最是悠然。虽不知山外日月，却熟知山水之性，能北垄耕云，南溪钓月，纵然穷崖绝谷亦能应对自如…

Desc_563.en: For countless years, hunters have roamed the forests, learning the secret ways of beasts until man and creature seem as one. With a single command, tigers and wolves scatter, and eagles swoop down to strike...
Desc_563.cn: 猎户穿山入林，寻鸟觅兽，如此经年累月，已然深谙鸟兽习性，更似与之心照神交，一声令下，则能使虎豹豺兕伏窜袭敌，雕鹗鹰鹞鼓翼伤人…

Desc_564.en: Artisans master the arts of Smithing, weaving, jewelcrafting, and Carpentry; with their skillful hands, they fashion garments, official attire, and vehicles for the common folk, or treasured swords and fine instruments to delight the noble and dignitary...
Desc_564.cn: 匠人通晓锻造、织锦、巧匠、制木之技艺，一双妙手可制衣冠船车，方便黎民百姓；亦能造宝剑名琴，愉悦达官贵胄…

Desc_565.en: Martial artists study all martial arts with chivalric hearts and wander the Martial World for years. Their daring deeds and towering spirit earn them universal admiration among martial folk. Even Outlaws and Xiakes willingly heed their commands...
Desc_565.cn: 武师习天下武艺，怀侠义之心，闯荡江湖，不知数载，因行事豪勇，壮气凌云，而广得武林人士敬佩，世间外道、义士更甘愿听其号令，为其驱从…

Desc_566.en: Scholars study modern texts and ancient lore with a broad view, amassing volumes of wisdom. With their abundant learning, they speak eloquently as if every word were convincing...
Desc_566.cn: 才俊读今人之书，阅古人之世，达观今古，积累万卷之才，凭满腹诗书侃侃而谈，好似无论所言何物，皆能令人信服…

Desc_567.en: Taoists cultivate the Tao and save the world. When their virtue exceeds eight hundred measures and hidden merits reach three thousand, they may ascend into the true Yang realm, riding cranes among the clouds as immortals...
Desc_567.cn: 道长修真学道，济世救人，待将德行修逾八百，阴功积满三千，便可飞入真阳清境，跨鹤凌云做神仙…

Desc_568.en: Eminent monks meditate on the Buddha's teachings with compassion, relieving suffering and guiding the lost. When all beings are saved and Bodhi is attained, they understand and escape reincarnations without falling into evil or affliction...
Desc_568.cn: 高僧参佛悟道，慈悲为怀，救苦救难，待到众生尽度，菩提得证，自能了悟轮回，脱离六道轮回，不堕三恶道，不受诸苦毒…

Desc_569.en: Gallants of the Martial World make friends over cups of wine. At every gathering, they drink heartily, sing wildly, and sometimes duel with swords in spirited contests—thus earning the saying, "After wine, they flaunt their flair; three cups down, they brandish blades..."
Desc_569.cn: 江湖豪侠，常在杯盏之间结交好友，每逢聚会之时，更是纵酒狂歌，荡乐娱心，甚或因兴起而横剑过招，一展身手，诗云“酒后竞风采，三杯弄宝刀”，是为豪客…

Desc_570.en: Highbornes shine across the martial world, their brilliance shaking the four seas. Commoners, authorities, and heroes alike revere their stately bearing. It is said that when they issue commands, even martial sects obey...
Desc_570.cn: 名门声名冠寰宇，光威震四海，不论平民权贵、侠客英豪，无不拜服名门风骨，对其万分钦仰，更听闻名门若有所令，武林门派亦将听从…

Desc_571.en: Beggars wander the dusty world, roaming the bustling streets year after year with a cheeky, unyielding spirit through the Martial World. Though they have no fixed abode, they live freely and adapt to every circumstance...
Desc_571.cn: 乞丐流浪红尘，常年混迹市井街头，凭自己一身顽皮赖骨闯荡江湖，纵然漂泊无定，也能逍遥自在，随遇而安…

Desc_572.en: Commoners, simple and unadorned, live peacefully and prize harmony. They value both neighborly kindness and family heritage, supporting one another through generations without interruption...
Desc_572.cn: 平民素朴，安居世间，常以和顺为贵，既重亲善邻里，更重家族传承，如此相互依傍，代代流传，千百年来不曾断绝…

Desc_573.en: Travelers roam the world in search of marvels and ancient lore, exploring the hidden and remote. Having trodden mystical streams and admired snowy, moonlit blossoms, they behold the splendor of the world with hearts as vast as the horizon...
Desc_573.cn: 旅人行走天地之间，喜爱搜奇访古，穷幽探绝，更因踏过奇水灵山，赏过雪月风花，将天下风光尽收眼底，自有一番广阔襟怀…

Desc_574.en: Wandering monks fear not the hardships of the road; with a staff in hand, they traverse the lands, having visited vast lands of Buddha and amassed boundless merit. Their radiant aura subdues all demons, which in turn submit...
Desc_574.cn: 云游僧不惧行路苦，拄杖游四方，因遍参无量佛土，修得无边功德，灵光护持，于是众魔摄怖，莫不归伏…

Desc_575.en: Doctors, guided by benevolence and skill, diagnose with careful inquiry, discerning life from death and tending to the urgent. They know the secrets of every herb and concoct miraculous remedies to save lives...
Desc_575.cn: 大夫秉持仁心仁术，望闻问切，可知病人之死生，救伤者之危急，更对世间百草了如指掌，调和奇方，悬壶济世…

Desc_576.en: Wandering taoists, well-versed in the Taoism and endowed with miraculous insight, wander the mortal realm—divining omens for the people, altering destinies, and even unraveling heaven's secrets...
Desc_576.cn: 云游道通晓道法，妙能通神，常年游走尘世之中，替百姓占卜问卦，改换天命，更可堪破天机，做个逍遥物外人…

Desc_577.en: Magnates, with fortunes numbering in the tens of thousands, display lavish generosity. They amass treasures from all corners and form alliances with fellow traders, profiting so that Silver flow into their purses like a river...
Desc_577.cn: 富商家财万贯，出手极为阔绰，广纳四海珍宝，受商贾追捧结交，往来得利，生财有道，竟使银钱更如流水一般落入口袋…

Desc_578.en: Cultured gentlemen and refined scholars delight in gathering over tea—a cup of spring water-brewed tea, both bitter and sweet. At every meeting, they discuss poetry and literature, engage in lofty discourse, and sometimes, inspired by the moment, take up the brush. The poem embodies the Noble well: "A lifetime as poet, through ages as tea sage"...
Desc_578.cn: 文人雅士素爱以茶会友，一盏春水煎茶，啜苦咽甘，每逢聚会之时，更可共话诗书，高谈阔论，甚或因兴起而磨墨执笔，一展才学，诗云“一生为墨客，几世作茶仙”，是为贵客…

Desc_579.en: In ancient times, royalty held high office; now they bear only empty titles. Though remnants of their former power linger, they do nothing but while away their days. They spend their time studying trivial pursuits such as crickets until they delve deeply into this passion...
Desc_579.cn: 昔日王公身居高位，如今只得虚名而已，虽仍有几分余威，却是无所事事，终日赏玩促织异虫，不知不觉，竟已将促织之事钻研至深…

Desc_580.en: A sickly bird circles the Sword Mound Monu Weave, with blue smoke swirling below—there must be fierce Severe Poison within...
Desc_580.cn: 剑冢莫女衣上有病鸟盘旋，冢下有碧烟缭绕，其中定有猛烈剧毒…

Desc_581.en: Where the baleful qi of the Sword Mound Spiritsealer reaches, grass and trees cannot grow, living things cannot approach. There is likely something extremely vicious within...
Desc_581.cn: 剑冢伏邪铁中煞气所至，草木不能长，生灵不能近，其中恐有极狠恶之物…

Desc_582.en: Snow falls in daylight on the Sword Mound Dark Frost, dripping water freezes instantly, all things are frozen and destroyed. Within must be like an icy hell...
Desc_582.cn: 剑冢大玄凝上白日飞雪，滴水成冰，万物无不冻毁，其中定如冰寒地狱一般…

Desc_583.en: The Sword Mound Fenghuang Cocoon is formed from golden threads, grows upon exposure to light, impervious to water and fire. Within must be indestructible...
Desc_583.cn: 剑冢凤凰茧由金丝结成，遇光则长，水火不侵，其中定然坚不可摧…

Desc_584.en: Among the Sword Mound Ignideus Blaze, peach blossoms are alluring, strange flames dance, mournful songs continue without end. Within must be able to disturb one's mind...
Desc_584.cn: 剑冢焚神炼间桃花妖娆，异火飞舞，悲歌不断，其中定会乱人心神…

Desc_585.en: The Sword Mound Candelor's Tail formed from loong bones, attached to the earth's veins, its power hidden. Within must be something that can resurrect the dead...
Desc_585.cn: 剑冢解龙魄由龙骨化成，附着于地脉之上，威能潜藏，其中定有死而复生之物…

Desc_586.en: The Sword Mound Vitalos is like white jade, constantly hidden within mist, formless when viewed, intangible when grasped. Within must be unfathomably unpredictable...
Desc_586.cn: 剑冢溶尘隐如白玉，时时隐入雾中，视之无形，捉之无质，其中必然变幻莫测…

Desc_587.en: The Sword Mound Demonbind lies within Blood Maple forest, amidst a sea of blood, the sounds of battle never cease. Within is filled with fierce and cruel qi...
Desc_587.cn: 剑冢囚魔木在枫林之内，血海之中，杀伐之声不绝，其中尽是无比凶残之气…

Desc_588.en: Above the Sword Mound Rainbow Ultima hangs a sun and a moon, radiant clouds covering it, mysterious and unfathomable. Within is likely beyond mortal imagination...
Desc_588.cn: 剑冢鬼神霞上悬有一日，又悬一月，霞光满布，诡秘难测，其中恐非凡人可以想象…

EffectiveAnswer_0.en: Sounds delicious. It makes one's mouth water...
EffectiveAnswer_0.cn: 闻之味美，实在令人垂涎……
EffectiveAnswer_0.ru: Звучит восхитительно. От этого у человека слюнки текут...

EffectiveAnswer_1.en: There's so much variety, and everything seems interesting in its own way!
EffectiveAnswer_1.cn: 种类繁多，样样都似乎有趣！
EffectiveAnswer_1.ru: Здесь так много разнообразия, и все кажется по-своему интересным!

EffectiveAnswer_2.en: The customs of this mortal world sure are charming...
EffectiveAnswer_2.cn: 尘世风俗实在可爱可亲……
EffectiveAnswer_2.ru: Обычаи этого бренного мира, несомненно, очаровательны...

EffectiveAnswer_3.en: I wonder how they preserve the vegetables...

EffectiveAnswer_4.en: The arch bridge is like a rainbow, and fishing along the streets is both beautiful and interesting...
EffectiveAnswer_4.cn: 虹桥如虹，临街垂钓，倒是美观又有趣……

EffectiveAnswer_5.en: The gardening skills on display are clear. This place must cost a fortune to maintain...
EffectiveAnswer_5.cn: 造园术实在精深，园囿所耗财力想必巨大……
EffectiveAnswer_5.ru: Демонстрируемые навыки садоводства очевидны. Содержание этого места, должно быть, стоит целое состояние...

EffectiveAnswer_6.en: The march of time makes one feel melancholy...
EffectiveAnswer_6.ru: Бег времени вызывает у человека чувство меланхолии...

EffectiveAnswer_7.en: I should pay a visit to one of these banquets for some tea and fruit...
EffectiveAnswer_7.cn: 不如去斋会逛逛，还可吃些茶果……
EffectiveAnswer_7.ru: Мне следовало бы посетить один из этих банкетов, чтобы выпить чаю с фруктами...

EffectiveAnswer_8.en: One can't help but yearn for those visions of the past...
EffectiveAnswer_8.cn: 旧时风景实在令人向往……
EffectiveAnswer_8.ru: Нельзя не тосковать по этим видениям прошлого...

EffectiveAnswer_9.en: Sounds delicious. It makes one's mouth water...
EffectiveAnswer_9.cn: 闻之味美，实在令人垂涎……
EffectiveAnswer_9.ru: Звучит восхитительно. От этого у человека слюнки текут...

EffectiveAnswer_10.en: Full of precious treasures, well worth visiting...
EffectiveAnswer_10.cn: 物华天宝，自是一处胜地……
EffectiveAnswer_10.ru: Полный драгоценных сокровищ, который стоит посетить...

EffectiveAnswer_11.en: The customs of this mortal world sure are charming...
EffectiveAnswer_11.cn: 尘世风俗实在可爱可亲……
EffectiveAnswer_11.ru: Обычаи этого бренного мира, несомненно, очаровательны...

EffectiveAnswer_12.en: Sounds fascinating! One would be lucky to run into such a creature!
EffectiveAnswer_12.cn: 听来可喜，若有幸遇见一二便好了！
EffectiveAnswer_12.ru: Звучит завораживающе! Было бы большой удачей наткнуться на такое существо!

EffectiveAnswer_13.en: These ancient relics are a boon for the current generation...
EffectiveAnswer_13.cn: 竟有上古遗物，实在是我辈幸运……
EffectiveAnswer_13.ru: Эти древние реликвии являются благом для нынешнего поколения...

EffectiveAnswer_14.en: The timely deeds of heaven, earth, and humanity, so that was how the name of heavenly kingdom was earned...
EffectiveAnswer_14.cn: 天地人和，天府之名原来竟是如此……

EffectiveAnswer_15.en: Each sound of the cuckoo's call makes people ponder...
EffectiveAnswer_15.cn: 杜鹃啼血，一声声叫人思虑……
EffectiveAnswer_15.ru: Каждый звук кукушкиного крика заставляет людей задуматься...

EffectiveAnswer_16.en: The legend of Yu the Great's mastery of the waves has passed through generations...
EffectiveAnswer_16.cn: 大禹人皇治水，功在千秋万代……
EffectiveAnswer_16.ru: Легенда о мастерстве Юя Великого управлять волнами передавалась из поколения в поколение...

EffectiveAnswer_17.en: Placed so high above, like an act of divine intervention...
EffectiveAnswer_17.cn: 山崖之高，不知是否有仙人相帮……
EffectiveAnswer_17.ru: Помещенный так высоко, словно это акт божественного вмешательства...

EffectiveAnswer_18.en: Living beneath a waterfall? How very interesting...
EffectiveAnswer_18.cn: 居瀑布下？当真是别有意趣……
EffectiveAnswer_18.ru: Жить под водопадом? Как это очень интересно...

EffectiveAnswer_19.en: The medical legacy of Guangnan is indeed unique. Can it cure one of the strange ailments?
EffectiveAnswer_19.cn: 广南医法果然自有渊源，或能治愈奇症？
EffectiveAnswer_19.ru: Медицинское наследие Гуаннаня действительно уникально. Может ли это вылечить один из странных недугов?

EffectiveAnswer_20.en: How could such a thing be so? I wonder what the reason is...
EffectiveAnswer_20.cn: 怎会有如此行事？其中究竟为何……
EffectiveAnswer_20.ru: Как такое могло случиться? Интересно, в чем причина?..

EffectiveAnswer_21.en: Perhaps everyone is connected to divine flowers, and that is why people are so sentimental...
EffectiveAnswer_21.cn: 或许人人皆与神花有渊源，倒是十分多情……
EffectiveAnswer_21.ru: Возможно, каждый человек связан с божественными цветами, и именно поэтому люди так сентиментальны...

EffectiveAnswer_22.en: With the masses gathering for song and dance, relations must be good...
EffectiveAnswer_22.cn: 众人齐聚歌舞，想必关系甚好……
EffectiveAnswer_22.ru: Когда массы собираются для пения и танцев, отношения должны быть хорошими...

EffectiveAnswer_23.en: From the description, it sure sounds like a dance of the divine.
EffectiveAnswer_23.cn: 听那形制，岂非如飞仙起舞？
EffectiveAnswer_23.ru: Судя по описанию, это определенно звучит как танец божественного.

EffectiveAnswer_24.en: Can anyone participate? I'd like to see this for myself...
EffectiveAnswer_24.cn: 旁人亦可参与？我也想去瞧瞧……
EffectiveAnswer_24.ru: Может ли кто-нибудь принять участие? Я бы хотел увидеть это своими глазами...

EffectiveAnswer_25.en: It was once considered difficult to create a song with a single string, but perhaps the world has now changed its view...
EffectiveAnswer_25.cn: 独弦难成曲，有此独弦琴，或许世人改观……

EffectiveAnswer_26.en: Plains of fire and mountains of ice... Perhaps this was once a place of the immortals...
EffectiveAnswer_26.cn: 炎地寒山，或许亦是仙人所舍……
EffectiveAnswer_26.ru: Огненные равнины и ледяные горы... Возможно, когда-то это было место обитания бессмертных...

EffectiveAnswer_27.en: This place must have witnessed much...
EffectiveAnswer_27.cn: 此地不知见证过多少风云……
EffectiveAnswer_27.ru: Это место, должно быть, было свидетелем многого...

EffectiveAnswer_28.en: Whose color never fades? What sort of dye could that be?
EffectiveAnswer_28.cn: 颜色不衰？是何原料可至于此？
EffectiveAnswer_28.ru: Чей цвет никогда не тускнеет? Что это может быть за краска?

EffectiveAnswer_29.en: Drums and gongs give storytelling a great energy...
EffectiveAnswer_29.cn: 锣鼓伴说书，有气势的很……
EffectiveAnswer_29.ru: Барабаны и гонги придают повествованию огромную Энергию...

EffectiveAnswer_30.en: To kill for money... Such a cruel way to make a living...
EffectiveAnswer_30.cn: 杀人越货，实在残忍无情……
EffectiveAnswer_30.ru: Убивать за деньги... Такой жестокий способ зарабатывать на жизнь...

EffectiveAnswer_31.en: To have constructed a path must have been a feat of engineering...
EffectiveAnswer_31.cn: 高处阁道，其制造应是很难……
EffectiveAnswer_31.ru: Проложить дорожку, должно быть, было настоящим инженерным подвигом...

EffectiveAnswer_32.en: What do songs of witchcraft sound like? Eee... ooh... something like that?
EffectiveAnswer_32.cn: 巫音是何音？吚吚呜呜么……
EffectiveAnswer_32.ru: Как звучат песни о колдовстве? Эээ... ооо... что-то в этом роде?

EffectiveAnswer_33.en: No wonder that... No wonder so many come here...
EffectiveAnswer_33.cn: 难怪有那……难怪世人来此……
EffectiveAnswer_33.ru: Неудивительно, что... Неудивительно, что так много людей приезжает сюда...

EffectiveAnswer_34.en: I've heard of the solemn beauty that the bianzhong can evoke...
EffectiveAnswer_34.cn: 我曾听说编钟之乐，庄严悦耳，十分动听……
EffectiveAnswer_34.ru: Я слышал о торжественной красоте, которую может вызвать бяньчжун...

EffectiveAnswer_35.en: Where is Wood Cave? Did he really ascend?
EffectiveAnswer_35.ru: Где находится Лесная пещера? Действительно ли он вознесся?

EffectiveAnswer_36.en: Is it due to the climate or the environment that such rich produce can grow here?
EffectiveAnswer_36.cn: 此地气候，能养出如此物产，或乃水土之故？
EffectiveAnswer_36.ru: Связано ли это с климатом или окружающей средой, что здесь можно выращивать такие богатые продукты?

EffectiveAnswer_37.en: If everyone helps each other out, it must be a blissful locale...
EffectiveAnswer_37.ru: Если все помогают друг другу, это, должно быть, блаженное место...

EffectiveAnswer_38.en: Was this because this place was the center of the whole Han Dynasty back in the day?
EffectiveAnswer_38.cn: 乃因汉时此地乃天下中心吧？
EffectiveAnswer_38.ru: Было ли это потому, что в те времена это место было центром всей династии Хань?

EffectiveAnswer_39.en: These giant Buddha sculptures came from the hands of devout followers...
EffectiveAnswer_39.ru: Эти гигантские скульптуры Будды появились из рук набожных последователей...

EffectiveAnswer_40.en: This must be the heritage of the Western Jin Dynasty, which must have influenced its people for generations...
EffectiveAnswer_40.cn: 想来是西晋之传承，人亦影响后人……

EffectiveAnswer_41.en: Why can't officials ride into the lanes? Do the villagers detest that?
EffectiveAnswer_41.cn: 为何骑马不入闾里？乡人不喜？
EffectiveAnswer_41.ru: Почему чиновники не могут выезжать на полосу движения? Неужели жителям деревни это не нравится?

EffectiveAnswer_42.en: It must be quite a lively scene...
EffectiveAnswer_42.cn: 庙祀醮赛想必十分热闹……
EffectiveAnswer_42.ru: Должно быть, это довольно оживленная сцена...

EffectiveAnswer_43.en: Who is this state governor? What great influence he had...
EffectiveAnswer_43.cn: 不知是哪位知州？影响如此……
EffectiveAnswer_43.ru: Кто этот губернатор штата? Каким огромным Влиянием он обладал...

EffectiveAnswer_44.en: The dead are long gone, yet the people remember him still...
EffectiveAnswer_44.ru: Мертвых давно нет в живых, но люди все еще помнят его...

EffectiveAnswer_45.en: Such a diet is customary for people living by the seas and rivers...
EffectiveAnswer_45.cn: 靠海靠河，而如此饮食，乃是风土人情……
EffectiveAnswer_45.ru: Такая диета привычна для людей, живущих у морей и рек...

EffectiveAnswer_46.en: This many fruits and melons, that it makes my mouth water...
EffectiveAnswer_46.cn: 许多瓜果，实在让人垂涎……
EffectiveAnswer_46.ru: Столько фруктов и дынь, что у меня слюнки текут...

EffectiveAnswer_47.en: One can avoid the cold of winter over here...

EffectiveAnswer_48.en: The materials for inkstone need the right time and place to form, and this is one such place...
EffectiveAnswer_48.cn: 砚台石料，需天时地利，此地得之……
EffectiveAnswer_48.ru: Материалы для инкстоуна нуждаются в правильном времени и месте для формирования, и это одно из таких мест...

EffectiveAnswer_49.en: The lychees are delicious? I hope it rains like this every year then...
EffectiveAnswer_49.cn: 荔枝十分味美？愿年年此日多雨……
EffectiveAnswer_49.ru: Личи вкусные? Я надеюсь, что тогда такие дожди будут идти каждый год...

EffectiveAnswer_50.en: There are big fish between the head and tail of the waters, how intriguing!
EffectiveAnswer_50.ru: Между головой и хвостом воды плавают большие рыбы, как интригующе!

EffectiveAnswer_51.en: The miasma of smoke is always troubling, and can destroy the human body...
EffectiveAnswer_51.cn: 瘴雾总是恼人，亦能摧折人体……
EffectiveAnswer_51.ru: Миазмы дыма всегда вызывают беспокойство и могут разрушить человеческий организм...

EffectiveAnswer_52.en: The foreign land of Nanyue, that's a place I'm longing to go...
EffectiveAnswer_52.cn: 南越外国之地，我有些向往……
EffectiveAnswer_52.ru: Чужая страна Наньюэ - это то место, куда я мечтаю попасть...

EffectiveAnswer_53.en: Perhaps this is a Land of Immortals made by the immortals, it makes one's heart linger...
EffectiveAnswer_53.cn: 或许仙人所设仙境，流连忘返……
EffectiveAnswer_53.ru: Возможно, это Страна Бессмертных, созданная Бессмертными, это заставляет замирать сердце...

EffectiveAnswer_54.en: The future generations are reaping what the ancestors sowed...
EffectiveAnswer_54.cn: 这便是前人栽树，后人乘凉……
EffectiveAnswer_54.ru: Будущие поколения пожинают то, что посеяли предки...

EffectiveAnswer_55.en: The teachings of Confucianism, spread to inculcate etiquette in people...
EffectiveAnswer_55.cn: 儒家之风，流传使人知礼……
EffectiveAnswer_55.ru: Учение конфуцианства распространялось для привития людям этикета...

EffectiveAnswer_56.en: The common folk learned to live according to the conditions of the lands...
EffectiveAnswer_56.cn: 因地制宜，百姓所以生存……
EffectiveAnswer_56.ru: Простой народ научился жить в соответствии с условиями своих земель...

EffectiveAnswer_57.en: Is it because of the influence of the sages here?
EffectiveAnswer_57.cn: 莫非是因为此地先贤影响？

EffectiveAnswer_58.en: It is wise to know and preserve etiquette, that is the behavior of the wise...
EffectiveAnswer_58.cn: 知礼守节，不过度，乃是明智之行为……
EffectiveAnswer_58.ru: Мудро знать и соблюдать этикет, то есть поведение мудрых...

EffectiveAnswer_59.en: Each of these visions may have its own meaning...
EffectiveAnswer_59.cn: 此类异象，各自或许均有含义……
EffectiveAnswer_59.ru: Каждое из этих видений может иметь свое собственное значение...

EffectiveAnswer_60.en: Such a thing would be an ingenious craft, I would love to see it for myself...
EffectiveAnswer_60.cn: 如此之物，巧夺天工，真想见识一番……
EffectiveAnswer_60.ru: Такая вещь была бы гениальным ремеслом, я бы с удовольствием увидел ее своими глазами...

EffectiveAnswer_61.en: Spiritual fruits growing in the mountains? Maybe I have eaten some in my travels...
EffectiveAnswer_61.cn: 山中产灵果？或许流传之间我也吃过……
EffectiveAnswer_61.ru: Духовные плоды, растущие в горах? Может быть, я что-нибудь съел в своих путешествиях...

EffectiveAnswer_62.en: According to the Medical Book, there is indeed an island of immortals in the East Sea, that person is very lucky...
EffectiveAnswer_62.cn: 方书所传，东海确有仙岛，那人幸甚……

EffectiveAnswer_63.en: Sounds delicious. It makes one's mouth water...
EffectiveAnswer_63.cn: 闻之味美，实在令人垂涎……
EffectiveAnswer_63.ru: Звучит восхитительно. От этого у человека слюнки текут...

EffectiveAnswer_64.en: Wonderful, the melodious words of Chu...

EffectiveAnswer_65.en: A thousand miles a day, riding the wind and waves, such a beautiful thought...
EffectiveAnswer_65.cn: 一日千里，乘风破浪，实在美哉……
EffectiveAnswer_65.ru: Тысяча миль в день, верхом на ветре и волнах - такая прекрасная мысль...

EffectiveAnswer_66.en: Go and pick aromatic grasses like a gentleman...
EffectiveAnswer_66.cn: 可去采佩香草，如同君子……
EffectiveAnswer_66.ru: Пойди и нарви ароматных трав, как подобает джентльмену...

EffectiveAnswer_67.en: The legend is beautiful and reminiscent...
EffectiveAnswer_67.ru: Легенда прекрасна и напоминает о себе...

EffectiveAnswer_68.en: Such beautiful scenery, how can one ever miss them?
EffectiveAnswer_68.cn: 十分美景，人怎能不去一观？
EffectiveAnswer_68.ru: Такие красивые пейзажи, как можно по ним скучать?

EffectiveAnswer_69.en: The white clouds hang empty in the sky...
EffectiveAnswer_69.ru: Белые облака пусто висят в небе...

EffectiveAnswer_70.en: Those who dwell in the peach blossom gardens, must be extraordinary people...
EffectiveAnswer_70.cn: 桃花源中人，当与我等不同……
EffectiveAnswer_70.ru: Те, кто живет в садах цветущего персика, должно быть, необыкновенные люди...

EffectiveAnswer_71.en: Was it the rumored mountain ghost? Did someone really see her?
EffectiveAnswer_71.cn: 便是传闻中的山鬼？当真有人见到？
EffectiveAnswer_71.ru: Был ли это тот самый горный призрак, о котором ходили слухи? Неужели кто-то действительно видел ее?

EffectiveAnswer_72.en: The common folk learned to live according to the conditions of the lands...
EffectiveAnswer_72.cn: 因地制宜，百姓所以生存……
EffectiveAnswer_72.ru: Простой народ научился жить в соответствии с условиями своих земель...

EffectiveAnswer_73.en: The environment here is very pleasant...
EffectiveAnswer_73.cn: 此地水土倒是十分宜人……

EffectiveAnswer_74.en: Historical origins all have their roots that can be traced...
EffectiveAnswer_74.cn: 历史渊源，皆是有根可循……
EffectiveAnswer_74.ru: Все исторические истоки имеют свои корни, которые можно проследить...

EffectiveAnswer_75.en: Women studying along with men? This would be very strange in the old days...
EffectiveAnswer_75.cn: 女子可同男子一同读书？旧时倒是十分稀奇……
EffectiveAnswer_75.ru: Женщины учатся наравне с мужчинами? В прежние времена это было бы очень странно...

EffectiveAnswer_76.en: If that is so... this place is akin to paradise...
EffectiveAnswer_76.cn: 如此说……此地竟仿佛神仙宝地一般……
EffectiveAnswer_76.ru: Если это так... то это место сродни раю...

EffectiveAnswer_77.en: Can we still travel to foreign lands by sea today?
EffectiveAnswer_77.cn: 如今可否再入海去外国？
EffectiveAnswer_77.ru: Можем ли мы сегодня по-прежнему путешествовать в чужие страны по морю?

EffectiveAnswer_78.en: The women here should be living rather comfortably...
EffectiveAnswer_78.cn: 此地女儿，应是十分自在……
EffectiveAnswer_78.ru: Здешним женщинам, должно быть, живется довольно комфортно...

EffectiveAnswer_79.en: No wonder I heard of red lotuses turning white...
EffectiveAnswer_79.cn: 难怪先前听闻有红莲变白……
EffectiveAnswer_79.ru: Неудивительно, что я слышал о том, как красные лотосы становятся белыми...

EffectiveAnswer_80.en: Is that so? Next time I'll try seeking the help of immortals at these stones!
EffectiveAnswer_80.cn: 竟然如此，那我下次也试试去石中求仙！
EffectiveAnswer_80.ru: Это так? В следующий раз я попробую обратиться за помощью к Бессмертным у этих камней!

EffectiveAnswer_81.en: There are more of some goods here than in the Central Plains, yet it lacks some others...
EffectiveAnswer_81.cn: 比中原多了些物什，亦少了些物产……
EffectiveAnswer_81.ru: Некоторых товаров здесь больше, чем на Центральных равнинах, но некоторых других не хватает...

EffectiveAnswer_82.en: I too wish to witness the rural hunting competition...
EffectiveAnswer_82.cn: 我亦颇有些想去看看乡射比赛……
EffectiveAnswer_82.ru: Я тоже хочу стать свидетелем соревнований по сельской охоте...

EffectiveAnswer_83.en: If I had the chance, I'd like to dress like that as well...
EffectiveAnswer_83.cn: 若有机会，我也想如此打扮……
EffectiveAnswer_83.ru: Если бы у меня была возможность, я бы тоже хотела так одеться...

EffectiveAnswer_84.en: Does that help to keep out the cold? I'll try that next time as well...
EffectiveAnswer_84.cn: 可以御寒？下次我也想试试……
EffectiveAnswer_84.ru: Помогает ли это уберечься от холода? Я попробую сделать это и в следующий раз...

EffectiveAnswer_85.cn: 那些药材原来自辽东来的……

EffectiveAnswer_86.en: The beacons of the old days are a memory in everyone's heart...
EffectiveAnswer_86.cn: 旧日烽火，自是人人心中记忆……
EffectiveAnswer_86.ru: Маяки былых времен - это воспоминание в сердце каждого...

EffectiveAnswer_87.en: That's interesting, let's go for a bath there one day!
EffectiveAnswer_87.cn: 十分有趣，择日便去沐浴一番！
EffectiveAnswer_87.ru: Это интересно, давай как-нибудь сходим туда искупаться!

EffectiveAnswer_88.en: Did someone really learn the melodious call of the deer?
EffectiveAnswer_88.cn: 呦呦鹿鸣，真有人能学此音？
EffectiveAnswer_88.ru: Неужели кто-то действительно выучил мелодичный крик оленя?

EffectiveAnswer_89.en: So... where can I ride this wind?
EffectiveAnswer_89.ru: Итак... где я могу оседлать этот ветер?

EffectiveAnswer_90.en: These are some unique tastes, who wouldn't want to try them?
EffectiveAnswer_90.cn: 风物独特，谁人不想一试？
EffectiveAnswer_90.ru: Это несколько уникальных вкусов, кто бы не захотел их попробовать?

EffectiveAnswer_91.en: Some of these are extremely rare in the Central Plains...
EffectiveAnswer_91.ru: Некоторые из них чрезвычайно редки на Центральных равнинах...

EffectiveAnswer_92.en: Clothes and food are simple problems to solve, as long as you have money...
EffectiveAnswer_92.cn: 穿衣、饮食岂不简单，只要有财便可安排……
EffectiveAnswer_92.ru: Одежда и Еда - это простые проблемы, которые можно решить, пока у вас есть деньги...

EffectiveAnswer_93.en: Then you can get close to the deer...
EffectiveAnswer_93.cn: 那便可以靠近与鹿群亲近……
EffectiveAnswer_93.ru: Тогда вы сможете подобраться поближе к оленю...

EffectiveAnswer_94.en: Grape wine in luminous glasses, who wouldn't want some...
EffectiveAnswer_94.cn: 葡萄美酒夜光杯，谁人不想……
EffectiveAnswer_94.ru: Виноградное вино в светящихся бокалах, кто бы не захотел немного...

EffectiveAnswer_95.en: A salty lake? Is it actually part of the sea?
EffectiveAnswer_95.cn: 咸湖藏盐？莫非其实是海……
EffectiveAnswer_95.ru: Соленое озеро? Действительно ли это часть моря?

EffectiveAnswer_96.en: Reading like this must be quite uncomfortable...
EffectiveAnswer_96.cn: 我若如此读书，想必会有些不适……
EffectiveAnswer_96.ru: Читать подобное, должно быть, довольно неудобно...

EffectiveAnswer_97.en: This Buddha grotto is an ingenious craft, and it seems to have been visited by many...
EffectiveAnswer_97.cn: 此佛窟巧夺天工，似乎多有人参拜……
EffectiveAnswer_97.ru: Этот грот Будды - хитроумное сооружение, и, похоже, его посещали многие...

EffectiveAnswer_98.en: That sounds quite dangerous, you should tread carefully...
EffectiveAnswer_98.cn: 听来有些凶险，行路更需小心……
EffectiveAnswer_98.ru: Это звучит довольно опасно, вам следует действовать осторожно...

EffectiveAnswer_99.en: So does that mean its climate is like spring all year round?
EffectiveAnswer_99.ru: Значит ли это, что его климат похож на весенний круглый год?

EffectiveAnswer_100.en: It's funny to talk like that...

EffectiveAnswer_101.en: The hair and clothing here are very unique, with its own sense of beauty...
EffectiveAnswer_101.cn: 此地发型衣装皆是十分特异，自有其美……
EffectiveAnswer_101.ru: Прическа и одежда здесь очень уникальны, со своим собственным чувством прекрасного...

EffectiveAnswer_102.en: Searching for a beautiful partner in the night, the moonlight must be very beautiful...
EffectiveAnswer_102.cn: 夜行寻佳人，想必月色甚美……
EffectiveAnswer_102.ru: В поисках красивой партнерши ночью лунный свет, должно быть, очень красив...

EffectiveAnswer_103.en: To choose not to be the head of a state and be a monk instead? That's...
EffectiveAnswer_103.ru: Отказаться от должности главы государства и вместо этого стать Монахом? Это...

EffectiveAnswer_104.en: The six clans are equally savage, this place is indeed a mixed bag...
EffectiveAnswer_104.cn: 六族皆蛮，此地真鱼龙混杂……
EffectiveAnswer_104.ru: Шесть кланов одинаково свирепы, это место действительно разношерстное...

EffectiveAnswer_105.en: Sending off in song... that's nice as well...
EffectiveAnswer_105.ru: Проводы в песне... это тоже приятно...

EffectiveAnswer_106.en: Can that really cure a disease? Perhaps it's worth a shot in the future...
EffectiveAnswer_106.cn: 当真能治病？往后可以一试……
EffectiveAnswer_106.ru: Может ли это действительно вылечить болезнь? Возможно, в будущем стоит попробовать...

EffectiveAnswer_107.en: Is it human? A tiger? Or a monkey?

EffectiveAnswer_108.en: I'd love to try some Guanyin tofu!
EffectiveAnswer_108.ru: Я бы с удовольствием попробовала немного гуаньиньского тофу!

EffectiveAnswer_109.en: Even beggars know such crafts? It seems to have spread far and wide...
EffectiveAnswer_109.cn: 乞儿也会如此伎艺？看来流传甚广……
EffectiveAnswer_109.ru: Даже нищие знают такие ремесла? Кажется, это распространилось далеко и широко...

EffectiveAnswer_110.en: The fleeting mists and clouds interwoven among the mountains, is quite a sight to behold...
EffectiveAnswer_110.cn: 云雾缥缈，奇山嶙峋，自有意境……
EffectiveAnswer_110.ru: Мимолетные туманы и облака, переплетающиеся между горами, представляют собой захватывающее зрелище...

EffectiveAnswer_111.en: The Four Treasures of Study are all gathered here, and literature thrives in this place...
EffectiveAnswer_111.cn: 文房四宝尽集于此，此地文学盛矣……
EffectiveAnswer_111.ru: Все четыре сокровища науки собраны здесь, и литература процветает в этом месте...

EffectiveAnswer_112.en: I've heard that crowstepped walls and Lingbi stones are unique to this place...
EffectiveAnswer_112.cn: 马头墙、灵璧石听说是此地特有……
EffectiveAnswer_112.ru: Я слышал, что зубчатые стены и камни Лингби уникальны для этого места...

EffectiveAnswer_113.en: No wonder I've often heard of some famous people who come from this place...
EffectiveAnswer_113.cn: 难怪曾听闻一些大人物来自此地……
EffectiveAnswer_113.ru: Неудивительно, что я часто слышал о некоторых известных людях, которые родом из этого места...

EffectiveAnswer_114.en: Then let's go and drink some Huangya Tea...
EffectiveAnswer_114.ru: Тогда давай пойдем и выпьем немного чая Хуанъя...

EffectiveAnswer_115.en: It's sad, lamentable, and worthy of song...
EffectiveAnswer_115.ru: Это печально, прискорбно и достойно песни...

EffectiveAnswer_116.en: Xuanyuan, the Yellow Emperor, is deserving of becoming an immortal...
EffectiveAnswer_116.cn: 轩辕黄帝飞升去也是应当……
EffectiveAnswer_116.ru: Сюаньюань, Желтый император, достоин стать Бессмертным...

EffectiveAnswer_117.en: Silk is beautiful, and is something everyone wants to have, so it must have made them rich...
EffectiveAnswer_117.cn: 丝绸华美，人人皆想拥有，想必也富庶……
EffectiveAnswer_117.ru: Шелк прекрасен, и это то, что каждый хочет иметь, так что, должно быть, он сделал их богатыми...

EffectiveAnswer_118.en: Brewing tea and cooking snow, having leisurely tastes all year round...
EffectiveAnswer_118.cn: 烹茶煮雪，四时皆有闲情野趣……
EffectiveAnswer_118.ru: Заваривайте чай и готовьте снег, наслаждаясь неторопливыми вкусами круглый год...

EffectiveAnswer_119.en: The river tides are impressive, but even more so are the merry makers who congregate with the rising of the tides...
EffectiveAnswer_119.cn: 江潮震撼，更有弄潮人，一同生辉……

EffectiveAnswer_120.en: The Jiangnan Garden is unique in the world, where people make merry among the mountains and lakes.
EffectiveAnswer_120.cn: 江南园囿天下独步，因借山水，乃人之乐……
EffectiveAnswer_120.ru: Сад Цзяннань уникален в мире, где люди веселятся среди гор и озер.

EffectiveAnswer_121.en: If I meet them, I'd gladly try some liquor and desserts...
EffectiveAnswer_121.cn: 若我遇到，也想讨酒讨点心吃……
EffectiveAnswer_121.ru: Если я их встречу, то с удовольствием попробую немного Вина и десертов...

EffectiveAnswer_122.en: There may be some ancient ruins beneath these lands...
EffectiveAnswer_122.cn: 此间地下，或许有什么上古遗址……
EffectiveAnswer_122.ru: Под этими землями могут быть какие-нибудь древние руины...

EffectiveAnswer_123.en: It's both convenient and profitable. Isn't that amazing...
EffectiveAnswer_123.cn: 既便利又赚钱，当真十分了得……
EffectiveAnswer_123.ru: Это и удобно, и выгодно. Разве это не удивительно?..

EffectiveAnswer_124.en: So Jiangnan has such a saying...
EffectiveAnswer_124.ru: Так вот, в Цзяннани есть такая поговорка...

EffectiveAnswer_125.en: A flaming waterfall, what a scenery to behold...
EffectiveAnswer_125.cn: 火光中瀑布，该是何等奇景……

EffectiveAnswer_126.en: Huaiyang cuisine is wonderful! I would really like to try it...
EffectiveAnswer_126.cn: 淮扬饮食确实了得！我愿去吃……
EffectiveAnswer_126.ru: Хуайянская кухня великолепна! Мне бы очень хотелось это попробовать...

EffectiveAnswer_127.en: The rise and fall of societies in history is worthy of lament...
EffectiveAnswer_127.cn: 古往今来，兴衰更迭，令人叹惋……
EffectiveAnswer_127.ru: Взлет и падение обществ в истории достойны сожаления...

EffectiveAnswer_128.en: The people here really enjoy this...
EffectiveAnswer_128.cn: 此地民众确实十分会享受……

EffectiveAnswer_129.en: All sorts of people pass through here, where you can witness the cultures from everywhere...
EffectiveAnswer_129.cn: 人物来往贯通，便见四方文化……
EffectiveAnswer_129.ru: Здесь проходят самые разные люди, и вы можете познакомиться с культурами отовсюду...

EffectiveAnswer_130.en: It must be quite enjoyable to sit in a pleasure boat and listen to the song boats sing...
EffectiveAnswer_130.cn: 若坐在画舫中听歌船，也许十分惬意……
EffectiveAnswer_130.ru: Должно быть, довольно приятно сидеть в прогулочном катере и слушать песню, которую поют лодки...

EffectiveAnswer_131.en: Decorating with copper rulers, that's rather unique as well...
EffectiveAnswer_131.cn: 以铜尺作装饰，也许也十分独特……
EffectiveAnswer_131.ru: Украшение медными линейками тоже довольно уникально...

EffectiveAnswer_132.en: Bandits are deplorable, but also somewhat chivalrous...
EffectiveAnswer_132.cn: 这盗贼说来可恶，却又有侠义……
EffectiveAnswer_132.ru: Бандиты достойны сожаления, но в то же время в чем-то рыцарственны...

EffectiveAnswer_133.en: The white-haired old man strolls along, perhaps he's just here for sightseeing...
EffectiveAnswer_133.cn: 白首老人款款行，也许也是想游览……
EffectiveAnswer_133.ru: Седовласый старик прогуливается рядом, возможно, он здесь просто для осмотра достопримечательностей...

EffectiveAnswer_134.en: What could the twelve inkstones mean?
EffectiveAnswer_134.ru: Что могли означать двенадцать чернильных камней?

EffectiveAnswer_135.en: So that's how it is... Shaoshi Mountain must be a picturesque place...
EffectiveAnswer_135.cn: 原来如此……那少室山定然风景如画……
EffectiveAnswer_135.ru: Так вот как это бывает... Гора Шаоши, должно быть, живописное место...

EffectiveAnswer_136.en: These vegetables sound delicious.\nIt would be nice to try the vegetarian repast of Shaolin when there's a chance...
EffectiveAnswer_136.cn: 这些蔬菜听来便十分美味，\n若有机会，倒可尝尝少林素斋……

EffectiveAnswer_137.en: Sounds very serene... No wonder it's used as a place of enlightenment...
EffectiveAnswer_137.cn: 听来确是一处清静之地……无怪非能参禅悟道……
EffectiveAnswer_137.ru: Звучит очень безмятежно... Неудивительно, что его используют как место просветления...

EffectiveAnswer_138.en: How does the tomb of an Eminent Monk differ? I should take a look when I have the chance...
EffectiveAnswer_138.cn: 高僧之墓寝，又有何不同？若有机会，也当瞧瞧……
EffectiveAnswer_138.ru: Чем отличается могила выдающегося Монаха? Я должен взглянуть, когда у меня будет такая возможность...

EffectiveAnswer_139.en: Well water of different flavors? This is indeed unheard of...
EffectiveAnswer_139.cn: 井水竟还有滋味？确实闻所未闻……
EffectiveAnswer_139.ru: Колодезная вода разных вкусов? Это действительно неслыханно...

EffectiveAnswer_140.en: The splendor of Shaolin today owes much to the achievements of old...
EffectiveAnswer_140.cn: 少林之正大光明，原来古而有之……
EffectiveAnswer_140.ru: Сегодняшнее великолепие Шаолиня во многом обязано достижениям древности...

EffectiveAnswer_141.en: To have cut off his own arm... His devotion was truly far greater than the common man...
EffectiveAnswer_141.cn: 立雪断臂……既有如此决心，确是与凡人不同……
EffectiveAnswer_141.ru: Отрубить себе руку... Его преданность действительно была намного больше, чем у обычного человека...

EffectiveAnswer_142.en: Does something so amazing really exist? I definitely need to give it a try...
EffectiveAnswer_142.cn: 当真如此神奇？那我定然要试试……
